seg.abda31761e23.src: Plain answers to what buyers ask us, starting with how to check turmeric powder at home.
seg.abda31761e23.t: ग्राहकहरूले हामीलाई सोध्ने प्रश्नका सरल जवाफ, घरमै बेसार धुलो कसरी जाँच्ने भन्ने कुराबाट सुरु।
seg.abda31761e23.back: Simple answers to questions customers ask us, starting from how to check turmeric powder at home.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI को मापदण्डअनुसार बेसार धुलोमा लेड क्रोमेटसमेत कुनै पनि थपिएको रङ पदार्थ, र बाहिरी स्टार्च हुनुहुँदैन। यसको परीक्षण पुस्तिकामा निरीक्षकहरूले बेसारमा के-के जाँच्छन् भनेर लेखिएको छ: मेटानिल येलोजस्ता थपिएका रङ, लेडका लवण, र चकको धुलो।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to FSSAI's standard, turmeric powder must not have any added colouring matter, including lead chromate, or foreign starch. Its testing manual writes what inspectors check in turmeric: added colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: यीमध्ये केही तपाईं आफ्नै भान्सामा जाँच्न सक्नुहुन्छ, र केही ल्याबले मात्र पत्ता लगाउन सक्छ। यो गाइडमा दुवै छन्, साथै बेसारमा काम नगर्ने दुई चर्चित परीक्षण पनि। तपाईंले किन्ने जुनसुकै बेसारमा, हाम्रोमा पनि, यी जाँच गरेर हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can check in your own kitchen, and some only a lab can detect. This guide has both, as well as two popular tests that do not work on turmeric. Try these checks on any turmeric you buy, ours too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: बेसार जाँचपछिका पानीका दुई गिलास। बायाँ: फिक्का पहेँलो पानी, धुलो पिँधमा बसेको। दायाँ: गाढा पहेँलो पानी, धुलोबाट तलतिर पहेँला धर्सा झरेका।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: deep yellow water, yellow streaks falling downward from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧पानीको जाँच⟦/1⟧बायाँ: धुलो पिँधमा बसेको छ र पानी फिक्का पहेँलो छ। दायाँ: धुलो डुब्दै गर्दा त्यसबाट गाढा पहेँला धर्सा झरे, र पानी गाढा पहेँलो भयो। त्यसलाई ल्याबमा जाँच गराउनु उचित हुन्छ।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled at the bottom and the water is pale yellow. Right: as the powder was sinking deep yellow streaks fell from it, and the water became deep yellow. It is proper to get that tested in a lab.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एक गिलास पानीमाथि एक सानो चम्चा बेसार छर्नुहोस् र नचलाई बस्न दिनुहोस्। बेसार डुब्छ र पानी फिक्का पहेँलो रहन्छ; तुरुन्तै गाढा पहेँलो हुने पानीले थपिएको रङतिर संकेत गर्छ। यो जाँचले लेड क्रोमेट वा चक पत्ता लगाउन सक्दैन, त्यसैले पक्का जवाफका लागि खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याब प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। आयोडिन परीक्षण नगर्नुहोस्: बेसारमा सुरुदेखि नै स्टार्च हुन्छ।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric on top of a glass of water and let it sit without stirring. The turmeric sinks and the water stays pale yellow; water that turns deep yellow immediately points toward added colour. This check cannot detect lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer use a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the start.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: जस्तै मेटानिल येलो, जसले फिक्का बेसारलाई चम्किलो देखाउन सक्छ। FSSAI ले बेसारमा रङ थप्न अनुमति दिँदैन।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make pale turmeric look bright. FSSAI does not permit adding colour to turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट र लेडका अन्य लवण
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट पेन्टमा प्रयोग हुने पहेँलो रङ हो। 2019 र 2024 मा प्रकाशित, स्ट्यानफोर्डको अगुवाइमा भएका अध्ययनहरूले दक्षिण एसियाका केही भागका बेसारमा यो भेटे। FSSAI ले बेसारमा यसलाई पटक्कै अनुमति दिँदैन।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow colour used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: अन्य बालीको पिठो वा स्टार्च। FSSAI को मापदण्डले यसलाई पनि निषेध गर्छ।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. FSSAI's standard prohibits this too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: पारदर्शी गिलासमा कोठाको तापक्रमको पानी भर्नुहोस्।
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: माथिबाट एक बराबर भरिएको सानो चम्चा बेसार धुलो छर्नुहोस्। नचलाउनुहोस्।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level-filled small spoon of turmeric powder from above. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: धुलो डुब्दै गर्दा पहिलो एक मिनेट हेर्नुहोस्। त्यसबाट तलतिर रङीन धर्सा झरेका छन् कि हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: Watch the first one minute as the powder sinks. See whether coloured streaks are falling downward from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 देखि 20 मिनेटसम्म छोड्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि गिलासलाई सेतो भित्ता वा कागजको पानाअगाडि समातेर पिँधमा बसेको धुलोमाथिको पानी हेर्नुहोस्।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or sheet of paper and look at the water above the powder settled at the bottom.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढा पहेँला धर्सा, वा केही मिनेटमै गाढा पहेँलो पानी
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: रङ थपिएको हुन सक्छ। त्यो ब्याच प्रयोग गर्न छोड्नुहोस् र जाँच गराउनुहोस्।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been added. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧यो किन काम गर्छ।⟦/1⟧ बेसारको आफ्नै पहेँलो रङ, करक्युमिन, पानीमा मुस्किलले घुल्छ, त्यसैले धुलो डुब्छ र पानीलाई हल्का मात्र रङ्याउँछ। मेटानिल येलोजस्ता रङ सजिलै घुल्छन् र पानीलाई छिटो रङ्याउँछन्।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, barely dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and colours the water only lightly. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧यसले के छुटाउँछ।⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट र चक पनि पानीमा घुल्दैनन्, त्यसैले यिनी मिसाइएको बेसार यो जाँचमा पास हुन सक्छ। ल्याब परीक्षणले मात्र यी छैनन् भनेर पक्का गर्न सक्छ।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with these can pass this check. Only a lab test can confirm these are not there.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: धेरै मसिनो धुलोले केही बेर पानी धमिलो राख्न सक्छ। धमिलो हुनु ठीकै हो; हेर्नुपर्ने कुरा सफा, गाढा पहेँलो रङ हो।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Being cloudy is fine; the thing to look for is a clear, deep yellow colour.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: सुकेको बेसारको एउटा गानो बीचबाट भाँच्नुहोस्। बेसार भित्रसम्मै पहेँलो-सुन्तला रङको हुन्छ, त्यसैले भित्री भाग बाहिरी भागजस्तै देखिनुपर्छ। फिक्का वा धमिलो भित्री भागमाथि चम्किलो पहेँलो बोक्रा छ भने सतहमा रङ थपिएको हुन सक्छ। यसबारे बेच्नेलाई सोध्नुहोस्, वा जाँच गराउनुहोस्।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one dried turmeric finger from the middle. Turmeric is yellow-orange coloured all the way inside, so the inner part should look like the outer part. If there is a bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inner part, colour may have been added on the surface. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: स्टार्च भेट्दा आयोडिन नीलो-कालो हुन्छ, र बेसारमा पिठो पत्ता लगाउन यो प्रायः सुझाइन्छ। तर बेसारमा आफैँ स्टार्च हुन्छ, त्यसैले जसरी पनि नीलो-कालो हुन्छ। त्यसैकारण FSSAI को आफ्नै पुस्तिकाले आयोडिन परीक्षण बेसारबाहेक अन्य धुलो मसलामा प्रयोग गर्छ।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested to detect flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so it turns blue-black anyway. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test on ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: बेसारमा लेड, मेटानिल येलो र चक जाँच्ने FSSAI का परीक्षणमा कडा हाइड्रोक्लोरिक वा सल्फ्युरिक एसिड प्रयोग हुन्छ। यी एसिडले छाला र आँखा पोल्छन्। यिनको ठाउँ भान्सा होइन, ल्याब हो।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests that check for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is the lab, not the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.t: पक्का जवाफका लागि: खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याब
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL मान्यताप्राप्त खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याबले बेसारमा लेड र थपिएका रङ जाँच्न सक्छ। ल्याबलाई कति नमुना चाहिन्छ सोध्नुहोस्, धुलोलाई सिल गरिएकै प्याकमा वा सफा सिल गरिएको झोलामा राख्नुहोस्, र प्याकमा छापिएको ब्याच नम्बर टिप्नुहोस्। FSSAI ले आफ्नो वेबसाइटमा सूचित खाद्य परीक्षण ल्याबहरूको सूची प्रकाशित गर्छ।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can check turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI इजाजतपत्र वा दर्ता नम्बर। यसलाई FSSAI को FoSCoS वेबसाइटमा खोज्न सकिन्छ।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. This can be searched on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: बनाउने वा प्याक गर्नेको नाम र ठेगाना।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of the maker or packer.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: खुद परिमाण, MRP, ब्याच वा लट नम्बर, र बेस्ट-बिफोर मिति।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: कहाँ उब्जाइएको हो। फरक क्षेत्रको बेसारको रङ फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले क्षेत्रको नाम लेखिएको भए उस्तै-उस्तैसँग तुलना गर्न सजिलो हुन्छ।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so if the region's name is written it is easier to compare like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: प्याकको जिप बन्द राख्नुहोस्, वा धुलोलाई सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा सार्नुहोस्।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or move the powder to a dry, airtight container.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। ओसिलो चम्चाले नै बेसारमा डल्ला पार्छ।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon itself makes lumps in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: सिधा घामबाट टाढा राख्नुहोस्, घामले रङ फिक्का पार्छ।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sun, sun makes the colour pale.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: धेरै चम्किलो पहेँलो बेसार नराम्रो संकेत हो?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: त्यत्तिकै होइन। रङ जात, उब्जाइएको ठाउँ, र कसरी सुकाइयो र पिँधियो भन्नेअनुसार फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले बेसार-बेसारमा धेरै फरक हुन्छ। ध्यान दिनुपर्ने कुरा: रङ धुलोबाट धेरै सजिलै छुट्छ कि छुट्दैन, पानी जाँचमा देखिए जस्तै।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. Colour differs according to variety, place grown, and how it was dried and ground, so it differs a lot from turmeric to turmeric. The thing to pay attention to: whether the colour comes off the powder very easily or not, as seen in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: के पानीको जाँचले बेसारमा लेड छैन भनेर देखाउन सक्छ?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water check show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: सक्दैन। लेड क्रोमेट पानीमा घुल्दैन, त्यसैले पानीको जाँचले यसलाई देख्न सक्दैन। ल्याब परीक्षणले मात्र सक्छ।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: It cannot. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: चिस्यानले। भिजेको चम्चा वा खुला प्याकले धुलोलाई पानी सोस्न दिन्छ। सुख्खा चम्चाले डल्ला फुटाउनुहोस् र प्याक बन्द राख्नुहोस्।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: From moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder absorb water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: जाँचमा केही गडबड देखियो भने के गर्ने?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What to do if the check shows something wrong?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: त्यो ब्याच प्रयोग गर्न छोड्नुहोस्, प्याक राखिराख्नुहोस्, र ब्याच नम्बरसहित बेच्नेलाई सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस्। FSSAI को Food Safety Connect एपमार्फत उजुरी पनि गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ। हाम्रो हो भने प्याक र गिलासको फोटो हामीलाई WhatsApp गर्नुहोस्।
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: हाम्रो बेसारमा पनि यी जाँच गरेर हेर्नुहोस्। केही ठीक नलागे प्याकको ब्याच नम्बरसहित फोटो ⟦1⟧हामीलाई WhatsApp गर्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧।
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Try these checks on our turmeric too. If something does not seem right, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the pack's batch number.

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडि कुरा भनेको आन्ध्रका घरहरूमा आइतबार दिउँसो पाकिने चिकन करी हो: हड्डीसहितको कुखुराको मासु खुर्सानी र बेसारमा मोलेर राखिन्छ, गाढा सुनौलो भुटेको प्याज र गोलभेडाको झोलमा पकाइन्छ, अनि अन्त्यमा गरम मसला हालिन्छ। यो तातो भातसँग टेबलमा आउँछ, र बचेको राति डोसा वा चपातीसँग खाइन्छ।
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi kura is the chicken curry cooked on Sunday afternoons in Andhra homes: bone-in chicken is marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked in a gravy of deep golden fried onion and tomato, and finished with garam masala at the end. It comes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers are eaten at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: यहाँको पिरोपन हाम्रो तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोबाट आउँछ, गुन्टुरको त्यो धेरै पिरो खुर्सानी जसले आन्ध्रका तरकारीलाई तिखोपन र चम्किलो रातो रङ दिन्छ; मसलामा हाम्रो बेसार धुलो पनि हुन्छ। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ र साँच्चै पिरो छ; पिरो कसरी घटाउने भन्ने कुरा सुझावहरूमा छ।
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, that very hot chilli of Guntur that gives Andhra curries their sharpness and bright red colour; the masala also has our turmeric powder. This recipe serves 4 people and is truly hot; how to reduce the heat is in the tips.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.t: जम्मा समयमा मसलामा मोलेर राख्ने 30 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: The total time also includes 30 minutes of marinating.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: कुखुराको मासुलाई दही, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो र नुनमा मोलेर राख्नुहोस्, अनि गाढा सुनौलो प्याज र गोलभेडाको झोलमा पकाउनुहोस्। अन्त्यमा गरम मसला र हरियो धनियाँ हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.9cb820880217.back: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a deep golden onion and tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and green coriander.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g कुखुराको मासु ⟦1⟧हड्डीसहित, करीका लागि काटिएका टुक्रा, धोएर राम्ररी पानी तर्काइएको⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, pieces cut for curry, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ कप दही ⟦1⟧बाक्लो, फिटेर चिल्लो बनाइएको⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧धेरै पिरो; मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा मात्र⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat only 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा तेल ⟦1⟧आन्ध्रमा प्रायः बदामको तेल प्रयोग हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.t: 3 वटा ल्वाङ, 2 वटा सानो अलैंची, 1 इन्च दालचिनी ⟦1⟧साबुत⟦/1⟧

seg.4a1335d92ae2.t: 2 वटा ठूला प्याज ⟦1⟧मसिनो काटेको, लगभग 2 कप⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप तातो पानी ⟦1⟧पातलो झोलका लागि अलि बढी⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.t: ⟦1⟧सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो⟦/1⟧ सँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: कुखुराको मासुमा दही, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो र नुन दलेर मोल्नुहोस्। 30 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्। तपाईंको भान्सा तातो छ भने कचौरा छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस्।
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub yogurt, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken. Leave 30 minutes. If your kitchen is hot, cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: बाक्लो प्यान वा कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा तेल तताउनुहोस्। ल्वाङ, अलैंची र दालचिनी हालेर केही सेकेन्ड चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon and let them crackle for a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: प्याज, हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पात हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onion, green chilli and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: प्याजलाई तेलमा गाढा सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। मध्यम आगोमा यसमा 12–15 मिनेट लाग्छ; नडढीकन एकनास खैरो होस् भनेर बारम्बार चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onion in the oil until deep golden. On medium heat this takes 12–15 minutes; stir often so it browns evenly without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट, अनि गोलभेडा हालेर नरम नहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्। काँचो गन्ध नजाउन्जेल पेस्टलाई 1 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्, अनि गोलभेडालाई थिच्दै 5–6 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, गोलभेडा गलेर छेउमा तेल देखिन थालेसम्म।
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomato and cook until soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomato pressing it for 5–6 minutes, until the tomato melts and oil starts showing at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धनियाँको धुलो हालेर चलाउनुहोस् र 30 सेकेन्ड भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: कुखुराको मासु हालेर, छोपेर मध्यम आगोमा हड्डी नजिक कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्। पहिलो 5 मिनेट नछोपी भुट्नुहोस्, टुक्राहरू अपारदर्शी नहुन्जेल, अनि तातो पानी खन्याउनुहोस्, छोप्नुहोस् र बीचबीचमा चलाउँदै लगभग 20 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add the chicken, cover and cook on medium heat until no pink colour remains anywhere near the bone. Fry uncovered for the first 5 minutes, until the pieces are opaque, then pour in hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: एउटा बाक्लो टुक्रा जाँच्नुहोस्: हड्डी नजिक कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहेपछि र रस सफा निस्केपछि मासु पाकेको हुन्छ। झोल चाखेर चाहिए नुन थप्नुहोस्।
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check a thick piece: the meat is cooked once no pink colour remains anywhere near the bone and the juice runs clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसला र हरियो धनियाँ हालेर चलाउनुहोस्। नछोपी 3 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्, झोल तपाईंलाई मन परेजति बाक्लो नहुन्जेल र माथि तेलको रातो तह नतैरिउन्जेल।
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Add garam masala and green coriander and stir. Cook uncovered 3 minutes on low heat, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red layer of oil floats on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: आगो बन्द गरेर पस्कनुअघि तरकारीलाई 10 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्; झोल थिग्रिन्छ र स्वाद मिलेर आउँछ।
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the heat and leave the curry 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavours come together.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: प्याजलाई गाढा सुनौलो हुनेगरी भुट्नुहोस्; झोलको रङ र बाक्लोपन यसैबाट आउँछ।
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onion until deep golden; the colour and thickness of the gravy come from this.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो धेरै पिरो हुन्छ। मध्यम पिरो तरकारीका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, वा कम पिरो र रातो रङका लागि सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium-hot curry use 1 teaspoon, or for less heat and red colour use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: हड्डीसहितका टुक्रा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; हड्डीले झोललाई गहिरो स्वाद दिन्छ।
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use bone-in pieces; the bone gives the gravy a deep flavour.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: मासु हाल्नुअघि गोलभेडाको मसलाबाट तेल छुट्टिन दिनुहोस्, नत्र झोलको स्वाद काँचो लाग्छ।
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before adding the meat, otherwise the gravy tastes raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरि कोडि कुरा: 3 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको नरिवल 1 ठूलो चम्चा खसखस र अलिकति पानीसँग पिँध्नुहोस्, र अझ भरिलो झोलका लागि यो पेस्ट गरम मसलासँगै हालेर चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a richer gravy stir this paste in along with the garam masala.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: पिँधेको मसला: 1 ठूलो चम्चा धनियाँको दाना, 1 सानो चम्चा सौँफ, 3 वटा ल्वाङ र सानो टुक्रा दालचिनी सुख्खै भुटेर पिँध्नुहोस्, र धनियाँको धुलो र गरम मसलाको सट्टा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast and grind 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, and use instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेसर कुकर: मासु र पानी हालेपछि 2 सिट्ठीसम्म पकाउनुहोस् र प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्।
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding meat and water cook up to 2 whistles and let the pressure release on its own.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: आइतबारको चलनझैँ बाफमा पकाएको भात र एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्। चपाती, डोसा वा रागि सङ्गटिसँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.8b4376996905.back: As is the Sunday custom, serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee. Also tasty with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: छोपेर फ्रिजमा 2 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस्; दोहोर्‍याएर तताउँदा भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तताउनुहोस्। भोलिपल्ट तरकारीको स्वाद अझ गहिरो हुन्छ।
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 2 days; when reheating, heat until it steams right through. The next day the curry tastes even deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आन्ध्रको चिकन करी कम पिरो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो घटाएर 1 सानो चम्चा बनाउनुहोस्, वा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, जसले उस्तै रातो रङ तर कम पिरो दिन्छ। अन्त्यमा एक चम्चा दही हालेर चलाउँदा पनि तिखोपन नरम हुन्छ।
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce the Teja chilli powder to 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour but less heat. Stirring in a spoon of yogurt at the end also softens the sharpness.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आन्ध्रको चिकन करी किन यति पिरो हुन्छ?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आन्ध्रको खानामा तेजाजस्ता गुन्टुरका खुर्सानी प्रयोग हुन्छन्, जुन अरू धेरैजसो क्षेत्रका तरकारीमा हालिने खुर्सानीको धुलोभन्दा निकै पिरो हुन्छन्। पिरोपन यो परिकारकै हिस्सा हो।
seg.ada87f188506.back: Andhra food uses Guntur chillies like Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder put in curries of most other regions. The heat is part of this dish itself.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: मासु भित्रसम्मै पाक्यो कि भनेर कसरी थाहा पाउने?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know if the meat is cooked right through?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: हड्डी नजिकको सबैभन्दा बाक्लो टुक्रा काटेर हेर्नुहोस्। हड्डी नजिक कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहेपछि र रस सफा निस्केपछि मासु पाकेको हुन्छ।
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut open the thickest piece near the bone and look. The meat is cooked once no pink colour remains anywhere near the bone and the juice runs clear.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can kodi kura be made without yogurt?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: सकिन्छ। मासुलाई खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो, नुन र 1 ठूलो चम्चा कागतीको रसमा मोलेर राख्नुहोस्, र झोलमा एउटा गोलभेडा थप हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the meat in chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one extra tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · आन्ध्र कोडि कुराको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. आन्ध्रको आइतबारे चिकन करी: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र बेसार धुलोमा मोलेर राखिएको कुखुराको मासु, गरम मसलासहित गाढा प्याज-गोलभेडाको झोलमा पकाइएको।
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आन्ध्र कोडि कुरा: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 वटा ल्वाङ, 2 वटा सानो अलैंची, 1 इन्च दालचिनी

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · बेल्लम पोंगलि · गुड़ वाला मीठा पोंगल

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगलि भनेको तेलुगु घरहरूमा संक्रान्तिको बिहान पकाइने गुलियो पोंगल हो: चामल र भुटेको मुगको दाल धेरै नरम हुनेगरी पकाइन्छ, अनि सख्खरले गुलियो बनाइन्छ र घ्यूले भरिलो बनाइन्छ। चाडको भोजअघि यसलाई नैवेद्यको रूपमा चढाइन्छ, र धेरै मन्दिर र शुक्रबारका पूजामा यही प्रसाद हुन्छ।
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal cooked on Sankranti morning in Telugu homes: rice and roasted moong dal are cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and made rich with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festival feast, and in many temples and Friday pujas this is the prasad.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: उखुको सख्खरले यसलाई हल्का खैरो रङ र भरिलो, टफीजस्तो गुलियोपन दिन्छ, र हाम्रो जीडिपप्पु प्याकका घ्यूमा भुटेका साबुत काजुले कुरकुरेपन थप्छन्। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.17053455adbb.back: Sugarcane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a rich, toffee-like sweetness, and whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack fried in ghee add crunch. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: पकाउने समय प्रेसर कुकरको हो; भाँडोमा पकाउँदा लगभग 15 मिनेट बढी लाग्छ।
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for a pressure cooker; cooking in a pot takes about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भुटेको मुगको दाल र चामललाई धेरै नरम नहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्, पगालेको उखुको सख्खर हालेर चलाउनुहोस् र टल्किलो नहुन्जेल मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। अन्त्यमा घ्यूमा भुटेका काजु, किसमिस र अलैंची हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice until very soft, stir in melted sugarcane jaggery and cook on low heat until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मुगको दाल ⟦1⟧पहेँलो फुटेको मुगको दाल (पेसरपप्पु), लगभग 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧yellow split moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप कोरेको उखुको सख्खर ⟦1⟧हल्का थिचेर भरेको, लगभग 150 g; अझ गुलियो मन पर्छ भने अलि बढी⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed and filled, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: एक चिम्टी खाने कपूर (पच्च कर्पूरम) ⟦1⟧चाहे मात्र; धेरै थोरै चिम्टी⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional only; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मुगको दाललाई हल्का सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, अनि चामलसँग धेरै नरम र गलेको नहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्। सुरुमा प्रेसर कुकर वा बाक्लो पिँध भएको भाँडोमा मन्द आगोमा दाललाई चलाउँदै सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्, भुटेको बदामजस्तो बास्ना आएर हल्का सुनौलो नहुन्जेल, लगभग 3–4 मिनेट।
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast the moong dal until light golden, then cook with the rice until very soft and mushy. First, in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, dry-roast the dal while stirring, until a roasted-nut aroma comes and it is light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भुटेको दालमा चामल हाल्नुहोस्, दुवैलाई सँगै 2–3 पानीमा पखाल्नुहोस् र पानी तर्काउनुहोस्।
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप पानी हाल्नुहोस्। मध्यम आगोमा 4–5 सिट्ठीसम्म प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस् र प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्, वा भाँडोमा छोपेर 25–30 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्, सुक्यो भने अलिकति तातो पानी थप्दै।
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. Pressure cook on medium heat up to 4–5 whistles and let the pressure release on its own, or cook covered in a pot on low heat 25–30 minutes, adding a little hot water if it dries.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: खोलेर डाडुको पछाडिको भागले चामल र दाललाई हल्का थिच्नुहोस्। यो सुख्खा होइन, नरम र जाउलोजस्तो हुनुपर्छ।
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open and lightly press the rice and dal with the back of a ladle. It should not be dry but soft and porridge-like.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: सख्खरलाई ¼ कप पानीमा पगालेर चामलमा खन्याउनुहोस्। सानो प्यानमा सख्खर र पानीलाई मन्द आगोमा चलाउँदै घुल्ने बेलासम्म मात्र तताउनुहोस्, लगभग 2–3 मिनेट; उमाल्नु पर्दैन।
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour onto the rice. In a small pan heat the jaggery and water on low heat, stirring, only until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: बाक्लो र टल्किलो नहुन्जेल चलाउँदै मन्द आगोमा 5–7 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्; 2 ठूलो चम्चा घ्यू हालेर चलाउनुहोस्। आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस् र पिँधसम्मै चलाउनुहोस्, किनकि सख्खर हालेपछि पोंगलि सजिलै पिँधमा टाँसिन्छ।
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Cook on low heat 5–7 minutes stirring until thick and glossy; add 2 tablespoons ghee and stir. Keep the heat low and stir right to the bottom, because after adding jaggery pongali easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: चाख्नुहोस्, र अझ गुलियो चाहिए अलिकति थप पगालेको सख्खर हालेर चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter stir in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: बाँकी घ्यूमा काजु भुट्नुहोस्; अलैंचीसँगै हाल्नुहोस्। सानो प्यानमा बाँकी 2 ठूलो चम्चा घ्यू मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा तताउनुहोस् र काजुलाई सुनौलो नहुन्जेल चलाउनुहोस्, लगभग 1 मिनेट; अन्तिम केही सेकेन्डमा किसमिस हाल्नुहोस्, फुलेर नआउन्जेल।
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry the cashews in the remaining ghee; add along with the cardamom. In a small pan heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee on less than medium heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute; add the raisins in the last few seconds, until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजु, किसमिस र घ्यू पोंगलिमाथि खन्याउनुहोस्, अलैंचीको धुलो र प्रयोग गर्ने भए कपूर छर्नुहोस्, र राम्ररी चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor if using, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: आगो बन्द गरेर मनतातो पस्कनुहोस्। राखिराख्दा पोंगलि बाक्लो हुन्छ; चाहिए केही चम्चा तातो पानी हालेर पातलो बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the heat and serve lukewarm. Pongali thickens as it stands; if needed thin it with a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: चामल र दाललाई पूरै नरम हुनेगरी पकाउनुहोस्; सख्खर हालेपछि ती अझ नरम हुँदैनन्।
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook the rice and dal until fully soft; after adding jaggery they do not get any softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मुगको दाल भुट्दा पोंगलिमा भुटेको बदामजस्तो बास्ना आउँछ; दाल खैरो होइन, सुनौलो होस् भनेर आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस्।
seg.c5408f916731.back: Roasting the moong dal gives the pongali a roasted-nut aroma; keep the heat low so the dal is golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: बाक्लो पिँध भएको प्यान प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र सख्खर हालेपछि चलाइरहनुहोस्; यो छिट्टै टाँसिन्छ र डढ्छ।
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it quickly sticks and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगलि अझै अलि खुकुलो छँदै आगोबाट झार्नुहोस्; सेलाउँदै जाँदा यो जम्छ।
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ताडको सख्खर: अलि गाढा रङको, अझ गहिरो र धुवाँजस्तो गुलियोपन भएको पोंगलिका लागि त्यति नै कोरेको ताडको सख्खर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: for a slightly darker coloured pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness, use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केर पोंगलि: फिक्का रङको, चिनीको गुलियोपन भएको पोंगलिका लागि सख्खरको सट्टा ¾ कप चिनी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: for a pale coloured pongali with sugar sweetness, use ¾ cup sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रान्तिको बिहान नैवेद्यको रूपमा चढाउनुहोस्, अनि चाडको भोजमा पुलिहोरा र गारेलुसँगै मनतातो पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: Offer as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve lukewarm at the festival feast along with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: बचेको पोंगलि छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। पस्कनुअघि अलिकति तातो पानी र थोरै घ्यू हालेर चलाउँदै तताउनुहोस्।
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Cover leftover pongali and keep in the fridge and finish within 2 days. Before serving, heat it stirring with a little hot water and a little ghee.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगलि र चक्केर पोंगलिमा के फरक छ?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: पोंगलि मात्र भन्दा प्रायः मरिच र जीरा हालेर बनाइने नुनिलो पोंगलि बुझिन्छ। चक्केर पोंगलि र बेल्लम पोंगलि गुलिया पोंगलि हुन्, जुन चिनी वा सख्खरले बनाइन्छन्।
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: Just saying pongali usually means the salty pongali made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet pongalis, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: बेल्लम पोंगलि प्रेसर कुकरमा बनाउन सकिन्छ?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can bellam pongali be made in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: सकिन्छ। भुटेको दाल र चामललाई 3 कप पानीसँग 4–5 सिट्ठीसम्म पकाउनुहोस्, प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्, अनि पगालेको सख्खर हालेर खुला कुकरमा मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water up to 4–5 whistles, let the pressure release on its own, then add melted jaggery and cook in the open cooker on low heat.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: सेलाएपछि मेरो पोंगलि किन कडा भयो?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali become hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: पोंगलि सेलाउँदै जाँदा जम्छ, र सख्खर हालेपछि धेरै बेर पकाउँदा झन् कडा हुन्छ। अझै अलि खुकुलो छँदै आगोबाट झार्नुहोस्, र बचेकोलाई तातो पानी हालेर पातलो बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: Pongali sets as it cools, and cooking too long after adding jaggery makes it even harder. Take it off the heat while still a little loose, and thin the leftovers with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: पोंगलिमा ताडको सख्खर प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can palm jaggery be used in pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: सकिन्छ। त्यति नै कोरेको ताडको सख्खर (ताटि बेल्लम) प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। पोंगलि अलि गाढा रङको हुन्छ र स्वाद अझ गहिरो, अलिकति धुवाँजस्तो हुन्छ।
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes slightly darker in colour and the taste deeper, slightly smoky.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: బెల్లం పొంగలి. संक्रान्तिका लागि बेल्लम पोंगलि: नरम पकाइएको चामल र भुटेको मुगको दाल, उखुको सख्खरले गुलियो बनाइएको र अन्त्यमा घ्यूमा भुटेका काजु हालिएको। 4 जनालाई।
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: soft-cooked rice and roasted moong dal, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery and finished with cashews fried in ghee. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगलि: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आन्ध्र चेपल पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रको इमली हालेको माछाको करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra fish curry with tamarind)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपल पुलुसु भनेको तटीय आन्ध्रको इमली हालेको माछाको करी हो, जुन गोदावरी जिल्लाहरूमा विशेष ध्यान दिएर बनाइन्छ: माछाका बाक्ला टुक्रा प्याज, हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पातसहितको अमिलो, रातो इमलीको झोलमा मन्द आगोमा पकाइन्छ। यो आइतबारको दिउँसोको खाना हो, र धेरै घरमा यसलाई माटोको भाँडोमा पकाएर भोलिपल्टका लागि राखिन्छ, जतिबेला झोल माछाभित्र पसिसकेको हुन्छ।
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is coastal Andhra's fish curry with tamarind, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish are cooked on low heat in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. It is a Sunday afternoon meal, and in many homes it is cooked in a clay pot and kept for the next day, by when the gravy has soaked into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: हाम्रो बेसार धुलो मसलामा र झोलमा जान्छ। सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले पुलुसुलाई गाढा रातो रङ र इमलीसँग मिल्ने एकनासको पिरोपन दिन्छ। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu a deep red colour and an even heat that matches the tamarind. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: तयारीमा मसलामा मोलेर राख्ने 15 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ। केही घण्टा छोडेपछि करीको स्वाद झन् मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The prep also includes 15 minutes of marinating. After resting a few hours the curry tastes even better.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: माछालाई नुन, बेसार र खुर्सानीको धुलोमा मोलेर राख्नुहोस्, प्याज र मसला भुट्नुहोस्, इमलीको पानीमा उमाल्नुहोस्, अनि नचलाई माछालाई झोलमा बिस्तारै मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish in salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onion and spices, boil in tamarind water, then cook the fish gently in the gravy on low heat without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g माछाका टुक्रा ⟦1⟧कडा मासु भएको माछा, बाक्ला टुक्रामा काटेको: रहु (बोच्च), कोरमीनु (मरेल) वा सीर माछा (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut in thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧कागती जत्रो डल्लो, 2 कप मनतातो पानीमा 15 मिनेट भिजाएको⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ सानो चम्चा बेसार धुलो ⟦1⟧¼ सानो चम्चा मोलेर राख्न, ¼ सानो चम्चा झोलका लागि⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for marinating, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 ठूलो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧1 सानो चम्चा मोलेर राख्न, बाँकी झोलका लागि⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for marinating, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.t: 1 सानो चम्चा नुन ⟦1⟧झोलका लागि, वा स्वादअनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.t: ⟦1⟧तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो⟦/1⟧ सँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: माछाका टुक्रालाई पानीमा दुई-तीन पटक बिस्तारै पखाल्नुहोस् र राम्ररी पानी तर्काउनुहोस्।
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Gently wash the fish pieces in water two or three times and drain well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: माछामा नुन, बेसार र 1 सानो चम्चा खुर्सानीको धुलो दलेर मोल्नुहोस्; 15 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्। मोलेर राख्न 1 सानो चम्चा नुन र ¼ सानो चम्चा बेसार धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder into the fish; leave 15 minutes. For marinating use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: भिजाएको इमलीलाई त्यसकै पानीमा राम्ररी निचोरेर छान्नुहोस्। लगभग 2 कप पातलो इमलीको पानी हुनुपर्छ।
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its own water and strain. There should be about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: चौडा प्यान वा माटोको भाँडोमा मध्यम आगोमा तेल तताउनुहोस्। मेथी, रायोको दाना र जीरा हालेर चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्, मेथी कालो नहोस् भनेर ध्यान दिँदै।
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add fenugreek, mustard seeds and cumin and let them crackle, taking care the fenugreek does not turn black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: प्याज, खुर्सानी र करी पातलाई तेलमा नरम नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; मसलाका धुलो हाल्नुहोस्। प्याजलाई नरम र हल्का सुनौलो नहुन्जेल लगभग 6–8 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट र गोलभेडा हालेर 2 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, अनि बाँकी बेसार धुलो, बाँकी सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र धनियाँको धुलो हालेर 30 सेकेन्ड चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onion, chilli and curry leaves in the oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onion about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: इमलीको पानी खन्याउनुहोस् र तेल माथि नआउन्जेल 10 मिनेट उमाल्नुहोस्। झोलको नुन हाल्नुहोस्; इमलीको काँचो गन्ध गइसकेको र झोल अलिकति बाक्लो भइसकेको हुनुपर्छ।
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until oil comes to the top. Add the gravy's salt; the raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should have thickened slightly.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: झोल चाख्नुहोस्। यो प्रस्टै अमिलो, नुनिलो र पिरो हुनुपर्छ, किनकि माछाले यसको केही भाग सोस्छ।
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish absorbs some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: माछा बिस्तारै झोलमा हाल्नुहोस् र छोपेर 10–12 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्; भाँडो घुमाउनुहोस्, चम्चाले नचलाउनुहोस्। टुक्राहरू एउटै तहमा मिलाउनुहोस्, माथिबाट चम्चाले झोल खन्याउनुहोस् र आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस्।
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Gently put the fish in the gravy and cook covered 10–12 minutes on low heat; swirl the pot, do not stir with a spoon. Arrange the pieces in a single layer, spoon gravy over the top and keep the heat low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: एउटा टुक्राको सबैभन्दा बाक्लो भाग जाँच्नुहोस्: मासु भित्रसम्मै सेतो वा अपारदर्शी भएपछि र काँडाबाट सजिलै छुट्टिएपछि माछा पाकेको हुन्छ।
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check the thickest part of one piece: the fish is cooked once the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes off the bone easily.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: हरियो धनियाँ छर्नुहोस्, आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस् र पस्कनुअघि पुलुसुलाई छोपेर कम्तीमा 30 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle green coriander, turn off the heat and before serving leave the pulusu covered at least 30 minutes.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: माछा नटुक्रियोस् भनेर चम्चाले चलाउनुको सट्टा भाँडो घुमाउनुहोस्।
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: So the fish does not break, swirl the pot instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: बाक्ला टुक्रा हुने कडा मासुको माछा छान्नुहोस्; पातला फिले लामो समय पकाउँदा टुक्रिन्छन्।
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm-fleshed fish that comes in thick pieces; thin fillets break when cooked a long time.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ। कम पिरो पुलुसुका लागि 1½ ठूलो चम्चा, वा आन्ध्रको सामान्य पिरोका लागि पूरै 2 ठूलो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or for normal Andhra heat use the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: माछा हाल्नुअघि इमलीको झोल राम्ररी उमाल्नुहोस्; माछा हालेपछि टुक्रा नफुटाई धेरै बेर पकाउन सकिँदैन।
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding the fish; after the fish goes in it cannot be cooked long without the pieces breaking.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो: अझ पिरो पुलुसुका लागि झोलमा सन्नमको सट्टा 1 ठूलो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। तेजा धेरै पिरो हुन्छ; निश्चित हुनुहुन्न भने 2 सानो चम्चाबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्।
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if you are not sure start with 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्यल पुलुसु: 400 g सफा गरेको झिँगे माछा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र गुलाबी भएर बटारिन थालेसम्म मात्र 5–6 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and cook on low heat only 5–6 minutes until they turn pink and start to curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाय पुलुसु: गर्मीमा गोदावरीका घरहरूमा काँचो आँपका चानाहरू हालिन्छ र इमली कम प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer Godavari homes add raw mango slices and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात र काटेको प्याजसँग पस्कनुहोस्। गोदावरीका धेरै घरमा यसलाई भोलिपल्ट पस्किन्छ, जतिबेला स्वाद मिलिसकेको हुन्छ।
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and chopped onion. In many Godavari homes it is served the next day, by when the flavours have come together.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: बचेको पुलुसु छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। प्यानमा नचलाई बिस्तारै तताउनुहोस्।
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Cover leftover pulusu and keep in the fridge and finish within 2 days. Heat gently in a pan without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपल पुलुसुका लागि कुन माछा सबैभन्दा राम्रो हुन्छ?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: बाक्ला टुक्रामा काटिएको कडा मासुको नदी वा समुद्री माछा: रहु (बोच्च), मरेल (कोरमीनु), भाकुरा वा सीर माछा। काँडा धेरै हुने साना माछा पनि चल्छन् तर बिस्तारै चलाउनुपर्छ।
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), murrel (korameenu), bhakura or seer fish. Small fish with many bones also work but must be stirred gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपल पुलुसु भोलिपल्ट किन झन् मिठो हुन्छ?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste even better the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: छोड्दा माछाले इमली र खुर्सानीको झोल सोस्ने समय पाउँछ, र अमिलोपन र पिरोपन एकनास हुन्छन्। त्यसैले धेरै घरमा यसलाई बिहानै पकाएर बेलुकाका लागि वा भोलिपल्टका लागि राखिन्छ।
seg.566bd302c316.back: Resting gives the fish time to absorb the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat become even. That is why many homes cook it in the morning and keep it for the evening or the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: करीमा माछा टुक्रिन नदिन के गर्ने?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: What to do so the fish does not break in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: बाक्ला टुक्रा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, झोल उम्लिसकेपछि मात्र हाल्नुहोस्, आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस् र चम्चाले चलाउनुको सट्टा भाँडो घुमाउनुहोस्।
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pot instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.t: 500 g माछाका लागि कति इमली चाहिन्छ?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind is needed for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: लगभग 40 g, कागती जत्रो डल्लो, 2 कप मनतातो पानीमा भिजाएर। गोलभेडा वा काँचो आँप हाल्नुहुन्छ भने अलि कम प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If you add tomato or raw mango use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: చేపల పులుసు · आन्ध्रको माछाको करीको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: చేపల పులుసు. गोदावरी शैलीको माछाको करी: प्याज, हाम्रो बेसार र सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोसहितको अमिलो इमलीको झोलमा मन्द आगोमा पकाइएको माछा। 4 जनालाई, सुझाव र प्रायः सोधिने प्रश्नहरूसहित।
seg.03c44db05afe.back: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish cooked on low heat in a sour tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आन्ध्र चेपल पुलुसु (आन्ध्रको इमली हालेको माछाको करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra fish curry with tamarind) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आन्ध्र चेपल पुलुसु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a6f8caae0640.t: गोंगुरा मांसम ⟦1⟧(अमिलो गोंगुरा पातसँग खसीको मासु)⟦/1⟧
seg.a6f8caae0640.back: Gongura Mamsam ⟦1⟧(goat meat with sour gongura leaves)⟦/1⟧

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मांसम भनेको गोंगुरासँग पकाइएको खसीको मासु हो; गोंगुरा एक अमिलो पात हो जसलाई आन्ध्र, र सबैभन्दा बढी गुन्टुर, आफ्नै ठान्छ। मासुलाई खुर्सानी र बेसारसँग नरम हुनेगरी पकाइन्छ, अनि गाढा रङको अमिलो पेस्ट नहुन्जेल भुटिएको गोंगुरासँग मन्द आगोमा पकाइन्छ, तरकारी बाक्लो भएर तेल माथि नआउन्जेल।
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is goat meat cooked with gongura; gongura is a sour leaf that Andhra, and Guntur most of all, considers its own. The meat is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then cooked on low heat with gongura fried until a dark sour paste, until the curry thickens and oil comes to the top.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुराको तीखो अमिलोपनसँग जुध्न कडा पिरो चाहिन्छ, र त्यो हाम्रो तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोबाट आउँछ, गुन्टुरको धेरै पिरो खुर्सानी, साथमा हाम्रो बेसार धुलो। भातसँग 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: To stand up to gongura's sharp sourness strong heat is needed, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, Guntur's very hot chilli, along with our turmeric powder. With rice it serves 4 people.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: खसीको मासुलाई तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो र अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्टसँग प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्, अनि प्याजको मसला र भुटेको गोंगुरा पातसँग बाक्लो भएर माथि तेल नतैरिउन्जेल मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the goat meat in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then cook on low heat with onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g खसीको मासु ⟦1⟧हड्डीसहित करीका लागि काटेको, धोएर पानी तर्काइएको⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g goat meat ⟦1⟧bone-in, cut for curry, washed and drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पात ⟦1⟧लगभग 2 मुठा (150 g), डाँठबाट टिपेर, धोएर राम्ररी पानी तर्काइएको⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 ठूलो चम्चा तेल ⟦1⟧प्रायः बदामको तेल प्रयोग हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: मासुलाई प्रेसर कुकरमा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट र नुनसँग राख्नुहोस्, राम्ररी मिसाउनुहोस् र 15 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: मासुलाई तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट, नुन र पानीसँग प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्। 1½ कप पानी हालेर मध्यम आगोमा 5–6 सिट्ठीसम्म पकाउनुहोस्, अनि प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्।
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the meat in the pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and cook on medium heat up to 5–6 whistles, then let the pressure release on its own.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकर खोलेर एउटा टुक्रा जाँच्नुहोस्: मासु नरम भएर चम्चाले सजिलै हड्डीबाट छुट्टिएपछि पाकेको हुन्छ। नभए अझ 1–2 सिट्ठी पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check a piece: the meat is cooked once it is tender and comes off the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook another 1–2 whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: मासु पाकिरहँदा, एउटा प्यानमा मध्यम आगोमा 1 ठूलो चम्चा तेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the meat is cooking, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium heat.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुरालाई हरियो खुर्सानीसँग थोरै तेलमा गलेर गाढा पेस्ट नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। यसमा 8–10 मिनेट लाग्छ; बारम्बार चलाउनुहोस् र पात ओइलाउँदै जाँदा चम्चाको पछाडिको भागले थिच्नुहोस्।
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts into a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and press with the back of the spoon as the leaves wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: बाक्लो कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा 4 ठूलो चम्चा तेल तताउनुहोस् र ल्वाङ, अलैंची र दालचिनी हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add cloves, cardamom and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: प्याजलाई साबुत मसलासँग सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। प्याजसँगै करी पात हाल्नुहोस्, र बारम्बार चलाउँदै 10–12 मिनेट दिनुहोस्।
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onion with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves along with the onion, and give it 10–12 minutes stirring often.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धनियाँको धुलो हालेर चलाउनुहोस् र 30 सेकेन्ड भुट्नुहोस्। मासु र त्यसको झोल हाल्नुहोस्, अनि गोंगुरा।
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Add coriander powder, stir and fry 30 seconds. Add the meat and its liquid, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: बाक्लो भएर माथि तेल नतैरिउन्जेल मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस्, बीचबीचमा चलाउनुहोस्, र 12–15 मिनेट दिनुहोस्। गोंगुराको अमिलोपन मिसिएपछि अहिले चाखेर नुन मिलाउनुहोस्।
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Cook on low heat until thick and oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and give it 12–15 minutes. Once the gongura's sourness has mixed in, taste now and adjust salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसला हालेर चलाउनुहोस्। अझ 2 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, अनि आगो बन्द गरेर पस्कनुअघि 10 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Add garam masala and stir. Cook 2 more minutes, then turn off the heat and leave 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा हालेपछि चाख्नुहोस्; यसको अमिलोपन मुठा अनुसार फरक हुन्छ।
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding gongura; its sourness differs from bunch to bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो धेरै पिरो हुन्छ। मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा, वा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; पूरै नहटाउनुहोस्, नत्र गोंगुराको स्वाद खल्लो र अमिलो मात्र लाग्छ।
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not remove it entirely, otherwise the gongura tastes flat and only sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुराका लागि आल्मुनियमको प्यान प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्; यसको अमिलोपनले धातुसँग प्रतिक्रिया गर्छ र तरकारी कालो पार्छ। स्टिल वा फलामको भाँडो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and turns the curry black. Use a steel or iron pot.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: गोंगुरा धेरै अमिलो छ भने सन्तुलन मिलाउन मसलामा अझ 1 वटा प्याज हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा चिकन: 750 g हड्डीसहितको कुखुराको मासु प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, प्रेसर कुकर नचलाउनुहोस् र गोंगुरा हाल्नुअघि मसलामा छोपेर 20–25 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, हड्डी नजिक कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहुन्जेल।
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, do not use the pressure cooker and cook covered in the masala 20–25 minutes before adding gongura, until no pink colour remains anywhere near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यलु: 500 g सफा गरेको झिँगे माछा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, प्याजपछि हाल्नुहोस् र गुलाबी भएर बटारिन थालेसम्म मात्र 5–6 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, अनि गोंगुरा हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onion and cook only 5–6 minutes until they turn pink and start to curl, then add the gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: रातो खुर्सानी गोंगुरा: अझ गाढा र तीखो तरकारीका लागि 6 वटा सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी गोंगुरासँगै भुटेर सँगै पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red chilli gongura: for a darker and sharper curry fry 6 dried red chillies along with the gongura and grind together.
