seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात र एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग, वा जोन्न रोट्टे (जुनेलोको रोटी) सँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्। साथमा काँचो प्याज राख्नु गुन्टुरको चलन हो।
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte (sorghum roti). Keeping raw onion on the side is the Guntur custom.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: छोपेर फ्रिजमा 3 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस्; दोहोर्‍याएर तताउँदा भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तताउनुहोस्। धेरैजसो अमिला तरकारीझैँ यो पनि भोलिपल्ट झन् मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.a4e072616940.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 3 days; when reheating, heat until it steams right through. Like most sour curries this too tastes better the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुरा भनेको सोरेल पात हो, जसलाई रोजेल वा रेड सोरेल पनि भनिन्छ (मराठीमा अम्बाडी, हिन्दीमा पितवा)। पातहरू अमिला हुन्छन् र पकाउँदा गलेर गाढा पेस्ट बन्छन्।
seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and when cooked melt into a dark paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: गोंगुरा पातको सट्टा गोंगुराको अचार प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can gongura pickle be used instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: सकिन्छ, अप्ठ्यारोमा। भुटेको पातको सट्टा 3–4 ठूलो चम्चा गोंगुराको अचार हालेर चलाउनुहोस् र नुन र खुर्सानीको धुलो घटाउनुहोस्, किनकि अचारमा दुवै पहिल्यै हुन्छन्।
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, in a pinch. Instead of fried leaves stir in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce the salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मांसमका लागि खसीको मासु प्रेसर कुकरमा कति बेर पकाउने?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long to pressure cook goat meat for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: हड्डीसहित करीका लागि काटेको खसीको मासुका लागि मध्यम आगोमा लगभग 5–6 सिट्ठी। मासु सजिलै हड्डीबाट छुट्टिएपछि पाकेको हुन्छ; बूढो खसीको मासुलाई अझ 1–2 सिट्ठी चाहिन सक्छ।
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in goat meat cut for curry, about 5–6 whistles on medium heat. The meat is cooked once it comes off the bone easily; older goat meat may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटन कम पिरो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् वा त्यसको सट्टा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्, र 2 वटा हरियो खुर्सानी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। केही पिरो भने राख्नुहोस्, किनकि यसले गोंगुराको अमिलोपन सन्तुलनमा राख्छ।
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or put Sannam chilli powder instead, and use 2 green chillies. But keep some heat, because it keeps the gongura's sourness in balance.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: గోంగూర మాంసం. गुन्टुर शैलीको गोंगुरा मटन: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र बेसार धुलोसँग पकाइएको खसीको मासु, अनि अमिलो सोरेल पातसँग बाक्लो नहुन्जेल मन्द आगोमा पकाइएको।
seg.df5186f8f459.back: గోంగూర మాంసం. Guntur-style gongura mutton: goat meat cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked on low heat with sour sorrel leaves until thick.

seg.ba26416f3fd1.t: गोंगुरा मांसम (अमिलो गोंगुरा पातसँग खसीको मासु) · 1acrefarms
seg.ba26416f3fd1.back: Gongura Mamsam (goat meat with sour gongura leaves) · 1acrefarms

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मांसम: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.91eb7853c772.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडि ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रको अमिलो गोंगुरा पातको चटनी)⟦/1⟧
seg.91eb7853c772.back: Gongura Pachadi ⟦1⟧(Andhra sour gongura leaf chutney)⟦/1⟧

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडि आन्ध्रको सबैभन्दा चिनिने चटनी हो: अमिलो गोंगुरा (सोरेल) पात तेलमा गलुन्जेल भुटेर भुटेको मसला, लसुन र रातो खुर्सानीसँग पिँधिन्छ। गुन्टुर र पलनाडुतिर यो लगभग हरेक दिन खानामा हुन्छ, एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग तातो भातमा मुछेर, साथमा काटेको प्याज राखेर।
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is Andhra's best-known chutney: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves are fried in oil until they melt and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is in the meal almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with chopped onion on the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोले यसलाई गाढा रातो रङ र पातको अमिलोपनसँग जुध्ने तीखो पिरो दिन्छ। यो रेसिपीले लगभग 1½ कप बन्छ, 6 जनालाई पुग्ने।
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and a sharp heat that stands up to the leaf's sourness. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: जम्मा समयमा पिँध्नुअघि पात र मसला सेलाउने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time also includes the time to cool the leaves and spices before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुरा पातलाई तेलमा गाढा रङको लेदो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, अनि भुटेको धनियाँ, मेथी, लसुन, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुनसँग पिँध्नुहोस्। अन्त्यमा रायो र दालको तड्का लगाउनुहोस्।
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry the gongura leaves in oil until a dark-coloured mash, then grind with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end temper with mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुरा पात ⟦1⟧2 ठूला मुठाबाट टिपेको, लगभग 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.t: 1 ठूलो चम्चा तिलको तेल ⟦1⟧पात भुट्नका लागि⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ सानो चम्चा मेथीको दाना ⟦1⟧मेन्तुलु; यो भन्दा बढी नहाल्नुहोस्, नत्र पच्चडि तितो हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; do not add more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧धेरै पिरो; कम पिरो पच्चडिका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुरा पात डाँठबाट टिपेर 2–3 पानीमा पखाल्नुहोस्। कपडामा फिँजाएर थपथपाउँदै पूरै सुकाउनुहोस्; पातमा रहेको पानी तेलमा छिट्छ र पच्चडि टिक्ने समय घटाउँछ।
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pick the gongura leaves from the stems and wash in 2–3 waters. Spread on a cloth and pat until fully dry; water left on the leaves splatters in the oil and reduces how long the pachadi keeps.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धनियाँ, जीरा र मेथीलाई बास्ना नआउन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; सेलाउन दिनुहोस्। सुख्खा प्यानमा मन्द आगोमा लगातार चलाउनुहोस्: मेथी एक रङ मात्र गाढा हुनुपर्छ, लगभग 2 मिनेट, तर खैरो होइन।
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander, cumin and fenugreek until aromatic; let cool. In a dry pan on low heat stir constantly: the fenugreek should get only one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुरा पातलाई 1 ठूलो चम्चा तेलमा ओइलाएर गाढा लेदो नहुन्जेल 6–8 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्। चौडा प्यानमा मध्यम आगोमा बारम्बार चलाउनुहोस्; पात छिट्टै खुम्चिन्छन्, हरियोबाट धमिलो जैतुनी-खैरो रङमा बदलिन्छन्, र तिनको लगभग सबै पानी सुक्छ।
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil 6–8 minutes until wilted into a dark mash. In a wide pan on medium heat stir often; the leaves shrink quickly, change from green to a dull olive-brown colour, and almost all their water dries up.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पातलाई थालमा फिँजाएर पूरै सेलाउन दिनुहोस्, लगभग 10 मिनेट।
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसलालाई लसुन, खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुनसँग पिँध्नुहोस्, अनि पात हालेर छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्। पहिले भुटेको मसला, 6 पोटी लसुन, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुनलाई मोटो धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse briefly. First grind the roasted spices, 6 cloves garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: सेलाएको पात हालेर पानी नहाली 3–4 पटक छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्, मोटो पेस्ट हुनेगरी। आन्ध्रका धेरै घरमा यसको सट्टा ढुंगाको खलमा (रोलु) कुटिन्छ।
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 short times without adding water, to a coarse paste. In many Andhra homes it is pounded in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: चाख्नुहोस्: यो अमिलो, पिरो र राम्ररी नुनिलो हुनुपर्छ। अमिलोपन धेरै तीखो लागे अझ एक चिम्टी नुन हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels too sharp add another pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: बाँकी तेलमा रायो, दाल, रातो खुर्सानी र करी पातको तड्का लगाएर मिसाउनुहोस्। सानो प्यानमा 2 ठूलो चम्चा तिलको तेल तताउनुहोस्, रायोको दाना चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्, चनाको दाल र मासको दाल सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, अनि रातो खुर्सानी, थिचेको लसुन, करी पात र हिङ हालेर केही सेकेन्ड भुट्नुहोस्। यसलाई पच्चडिमाथि खन्याएर राम्ररी चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: Temper mustard, dal, red chilli and curry leaves in the remaining oil and mix in. In a small pan heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chilli, crushed garlic, curry leaves and hing and fry a few seconds. Pour this over the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: सकिन्छ भने स्वाद मिलोस् भनेर पच्चडिलाई 30 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्, अनि सफा, सुख्खा सिसाको बट्टामा चम्चाले भर्नुहोस्।
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible leave the pachadi 30 minutes so the flavours blend, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: पच्चडि धेरै दिन टिकोस् भनेर भुट्नुअघि पात पूरै सुकाउनुहोस्।
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: So the pachadi keeps many days, dry the leaves fully before frying.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो धेरै पिरो हुन्छ। कम पिरो पच्चडिका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा, वा आधा तेजा र आधा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथी ¼ सानो चम्चा मात्र राख्नुहोस् र एक रङ मात्र गाढा हुनेगरी भुट्नुहोस्; बढी हाले वा बढी गाढा भुटे पच्चडि तितो हुन्छ।
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek to only ¼ teaspoon and roast it only one shade darker; if you add more or roast it darker the pachadi becomes bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्, चिल्लो नपिँध्नुहोस्: गोंगुरा पच्चडि मोटो हुनुपर्छ, पातका टुक्रा देखिने गरी।
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse briefly, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with pieces of leaf visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तेल कम नगर्नुहोस्; माथिको तेलको तहले पच्चडिलाई टिकाउन मद्दत गर्छ।
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not reduce the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: प्याजसँग: पस्कनुअघि मात्र एक भागमा मसिनो काटेको 1 सानो प्याज मिसाउनुहोस्, र त्यही दिन खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: just before serving mix 1 small finely chopped onion into one portion, and finish it the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: साबुत रातो खुर्सानी: खुर्सानीको धुलोको सट्टा 12–15 वटा सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी थोरै तेलमा भुटेर मसलासँग पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chilli: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हरियो खुर्सानी गोंगुरा: अझ तीखो, हरियो खुर्सानीको पिरोका लागि 6–8 वटा हरियो खुर्सानी पातसँगै भुट्नुहोस् र खुर्सानीको धुलो घटाएर 1 सानो चम्चा बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: for a sharper, green-chilli heat fry 6–8 green chillies along with the leaves and reduce the chilli powder to 1 teaspoon.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: एक चम्चा तातो भातमा घ्यूसँग मुछेर, साथमा काटेको काँचो प्याज राखेर खानुहोस्। डोसा, इडलीसँग र आन्ध्रको जुनसुकै थालीमा साइडको रूपमा पनि मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Eat mixed into a spoon of hot rice with ghee, with chopped raw onion on the side. Also tasty with dosa, idli and as a side in any Andhra thali.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: सफा, सुख्खा सिसाको बट्टामा फ्रिजमा 2 हप्तासम्म राख्नुहोस्, सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्दै। माथिको पातलो तेलको तहले यसलाई टिकाउन मद्दत गर्छ।
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. The thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा रोजेल बिरुवाको पात हो, जुन प्रायः सोरेल पात वा रेड सोरेलको नामले बिक्छ। हिन्दी र मराठी बोलिने क्षेत्रमा यसलाई अम्बाडी भनिन्छ।
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, usually sold under the name sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडि कम अमिलो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: अलिकति बढी नुन र खुर्सानी हाल्नुहोस्, वा 1 सानो चम्चा कोरेको सख्खर मिसाउनुहोस्। पातलाई राम्ररी गलुन्जेल भुट्दा पनि अमिलोपन नरम हुन्छ।
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or mix in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves until well melted also softens the sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: मेरो गोंगुरा पच्चडि किन तितो भयो?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why did my gongura pachadi turn bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: प्रायः धेरै मेथी हालेर, वा मेथी धेरै गाढा भुटेर। ¼ सानो चम्चा मात्र राख्नुहोस् र एक रङ गाढा भएपछि भुट्न रोक्नुहोस्।
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Usually from adding too much fenugreek, or roasting the fenugreek too dark. Keep only ¼ teaspoon and stop roasting once it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How many days does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: पात राम्ररी सुकाइएको थियो र सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ भने सुख्खा सिसाको बट्टामा फ्रिजमा लगभग 2 हप्ता। फ्रिजबाहिर 2–3 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.693b158b80df.back: If the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon, about 2 weeks in a dry glass jar in the fridge. Outside the fridge finish within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. गुन्टुर शैलीको गोंगुरा पच्चडि: गलुन्जेल भुटेको सोरेल पात, भुटेको मसला, लसुन र तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोसँग पिँधेर तड्का लगाइएको। 6 जनालाई।
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: sorrel leaves fried until melted, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder and tempered. For 6 people.

seg.0f19ba49c232.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडि (आन्ध्रको अमिलो गोंगुरा पातको चटनी) · 1acrefarms
seg.0f19ba49c232.back: Gongura Pachadi (Andhra sour gongura leaf chutney) · 1acrefarms

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडि: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(इमलीको झोलमा आन्ध्रको अण्डा करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु आन्ध्रको अण्डा करी हो, जुन घरमा मासु नहुँदा धेरै घरमा बनाइन्छ: पूरै उमालेका अण्डा इमली र बिस्तारै भुटेको प्याजको अमिलो झोलमा मन्द आगोमा पकाइन्छ। यो उत्तर भारतको अण्डा करीभन्दा पातलो र अमिलो हुन्छ, प्रशस्त तातो भातमा मुछेर खान बनाइएको।
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is Andhra's egg curry, made in many homes when there is no meat in the house: fully boiled eggs are cooked on low heat in a sour gravy of tamarind and slowly fried onion. It is thinner and more sour than north Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: हाम्रो सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले पुलुसुलाई रातो रङ र एकनासको मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ, र हाम्रो बेसार धुलो (पसुपु) ले सुनौलो आधार दिन्छ। अलिकति सख्खरले अमिलोपनलाई मिलाउँछ।
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu red colour and an even medium heat, and our turmeric powder (pasupu) gives a golden base. A little jaggery balances the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: अण्डा उमालेर चिर्नुहोस्। प्याज भुट्नुहोस्, बेसार, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र इमलीको पानी हालेर मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्, अनि झोल बाक्लो नहुन्जेल अण्डालाई झोलमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and slit them. Fry onion, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water and cook on low heat, then cook the eggs in the gravy until the gravy thickens.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.t: एक चिम्टी बेसार धुलो ⟦1⟧अण्डा भुट्नका लागि (चाहे मात्र)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional only)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g इमली ⟦1⟧कागती जत्रो डल्लो, 1½ कप मनतातो पानीमा भिजाएको⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा तेल ⟦1⟧बदाम वा तिलको तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧मध्यम पिरो; कम पिरोका लागि 1½ सानो चम्चा⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; for less heat 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: इमलीलाई मनतातो पानीमा 15 मिनेट भिजाउनुहोस्। राम्ररी निचोरेर छान्नुहोस् र इमलीको पानी राख्नुहोस्; रेसा र बिउ फ्याँक्नुहोस्।
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water 15 minutes. Squeeze well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away the fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: अण्डालाई 10 मिनेट उमाल्नुहोस्, बोक्रा छोडाउनुहोस् र हरेकमा 3–4 वटा कम गहिरो चिरा पार्नुहोस्। कोठाको तापक्रमको पानीमा राखेर सुरु गर्नुहोस्, पानी उम्लिएपछि 10 मिनेट गन्नुहोस्, अनि बोक्रा छोडाउनुअघि पानीमा सेलाउनुहोस्। पहेँलो भाग भित्रसम्मै कडा र फिक्का पहेँलो हुनुपर्छ।
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and make 3–4 shallow slits in each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes after the water boils, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: चाहे मात्र: 1 सानो चम्चा तेल एक चिम्टी बेसारसँग तताउनुहोस् र अण्डालाई त्यसमा 2 मिनेट हल्का फोका नउठुन्जेल गुडाउनुहोस्। छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्।
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: Optional only: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: बाँकी तेल कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा तताउनुहोस्। मेथीको दाना हालेर हल्का खैरो हुन दिनुहोस्; गाढा भयो भने तितो हुन्छ।
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in the kadai on medium heat. Add fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; if they go dark they become bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: रायोको दाना, करी पात र प्याजलाई तेलमा नरम र सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। पहिले रायोको दाना हालेर चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्, अनि करी पात, हरियो खुर्सानी र हिङ, अनि प्याज हालेर लगभग 8 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion in the oil until soft and golden. First add mustard seeds and let them crackle, then curry leaves, green chilli and hing, then add onion and fry about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: आगो मन्द गर्नुहोस्। बेसार, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुन, अनि इमलीको पानी हाल्नुहोस्; 10 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। धनियाँको धुलो खुर्सानीको धुलोसँगै हाल्नुहोस् ताकि त्यो पहिले केही सेकेन्ड भुटियोस्।
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the heat. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; cook on low heat 10 minutes. Add coriander powder together with the chilli powder so it fries a few seconds first.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: इमलीको काँचो गन्ध गइसकेको र झोल टल्किलो देखिनुपर्छ। धेरै छिटो बाक्लो भयो भने ½ कप पानी हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too fast add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: अण्डा बिस्तारै हाल्नुहोस् र झोल बाक्लो नहुन्जेल अझ 5 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। बीचबीचमा अण्डामाथि चम्चाले झोल खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Gently add the eggs and cook on low heat 5 more minutes until the gravy thickens. Now and then spoon gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: सख्खर हालेर चलाउनुहोस्, चाखेर नुन वा अमिलोपन मिलाउनुहोस्, र हरियो धनियाँ छर्नुहोस्।
seg.299781c49104.back: Add jaggery and stir, taste and adjust salt or sourness, and sprinkle green coriander.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस् र अण्डाले झोल सोसोस् भनेर पस्कनुअघि पुलुसुलाई 10 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the heat and leave the pulusu 10 minutes before serving so the eggs absorb the gravy.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: The slits let the sour gravy into the egg.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: उमालेका अण्डा बोक्रा छोडाउनुअघि पानीमा सेलाउनुहोस्; बोक्रा सफासँग छुट्छ।
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shell comes off cleanly.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ; अझ पिरो पुलुसुका लागि साथमा ½ सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो पनि हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu also add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder along with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: छोडेपछि पुलुसु झन् मिठो हुन्छ, र भोलिपल्ट अझ बढी, किनकि अण्डाले इमली सोस्छ।
seg.fc1643db807e.back: The pulusu tastes better after resting, and even more the next day, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: गोलभेडा: अझ नरम, कम अमिलो झोलका लागि प्याजपछि 1 वटा काटेको गोलभेडा हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a softer, less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onion.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तिल: अझ बाक्लो, भुटेको बदामजस्तो स्वादको झोलका लागि अन्तिम 5 मिनेटमा 1 ठूलो चम्चा भुटेको तिलको धुलो मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker, roasted-nut-flavoured gravy mix in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाय: गर्मीमा आधा इमलीको सट्टा काँचो आँपका केही टुक्रा झोलमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer, instead of half the tamarind, cook a few pieces of raw mango in the gravy.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात र एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग, साथमा कुरकुरे भुटुवा वा अप्पडलु राखेर तातै पस्कनुहोस्। चपाती वा डोसासँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with crispy bhutuwa (fried snack) or appadalu on the side. Also tasty with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: बचेको पुलुसु छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। अलिकति पानी हालेर प्यानमा बिस्तारै तताउनुहोस्।
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Cover leftover pulusu and keep in the fridge and finish within 2 days. Heat gently in a pan with a little water.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: अण्डा करीका लागि अण्डा कति बेर उमाल्ने?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long to boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: पानी उम्लिएदेखि लगभग 10 मिनेट। झोलमा हाल्नुअघि पहेँलो भाग भित्रसम्मै कडा र फिक्का पहेँलो हुनुपर्छ, बीचमा बग्ने भाग नभएको।
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from when the water boils. Before adding to the gravy the yolk should be firm right through and pale yellow, with no runny part in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.t: पुलुसुका लागि अण्डामा किन चिरा पारिन्छ?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why are slits made in the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: कम गहिरो चिराले इमलीको झोल अण्डाको सेतो भागभित्र पस्छ। चिरा नपारे झोल बाहिर मात्र रहन्छ र अण्डाको स्वाद खल्लो हुन्छ।
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy into the egg white. Without slits the gravy stays only outside and the egg tastes flat.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of the pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: केही मिनेट बढी मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्, एक सानो चम्चा कोरेको सख्खर हाल्नुहोस्, वा अलिकति पानी मिसाउनुहोस्। अर्को पटक इमलीको सानो डल्लो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Cook a few minutes longer on low heat, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or mix in a little water. Next time use a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: अण्डा पुलुसु र अण्डा करीमा के फरक छ?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु भातसँग मुछ्न बनाइएको पातलो, अमिलो इमलीको झोल हो। सामान्य अण्डा करी प्रायः प्याज र गोलभेडामा बनाइन्छ, इमली नहाली र अझ बाक्लो मसलासहित।
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, sour tamarind gravy made for mixing with rice. Ordinary egg curry is usually made in onion and tomato, without tamarind and with a thicker masala.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · अण्डा पुलुसुको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु, आन्ध्रको अण्डा करी: उमालेका अण्डा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र बेसारले रङ्गाइएको अमिलो इमली-प्याजको झोलमा मन्द आगोमा पकाइएको। 4 जनालाई।
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs cooked on low heat in a sour tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु (इमलीको झोलमा आन्ध्रको अण्डा करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडि गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कुरा ⟦1⟧(आन्ध्रको भरेको भन्टाको तरकारी)⟦/1⟧
seg.722d155a3c4f.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra stuffed brinjal curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.2dbfe36602c8.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Gutti Vankaya Kura · Bharwan baingan (stuffed brinjal)

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कुरा भनेको आन्ध्रका घरहरूमा आइतबारको दिउँसोको खाना, बिहे र पाहुना आउँदा बनाइने भरेको भन्टाको तरकारी हो। साना, गोला, बैजनी भन्टा चिरेर भुटेको बदाम, तिल र नरिवलको मसलाले भरिन्छ, र नरम भएर मसला टाँसिन्जेल तेलमा बिस्तारै पकाइन्छ।
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry made in Andhra homes for Sunday afternoon meals, weddings and when guests come. Small, round, purple brinjals are slit and filled with a masala of roasted peanuts, sesame and coconut, and cooked slowly in oil until soft and the masala clings.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: हाम्रो सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले भरिने मसलालाई रातो रङ र मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ, र बेसार धुलोले स्वाद पूरा गर्छ। तातो भात वा चपातीसँग पस्कनुहोस्। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.27fd58488499.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing masala red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder completes the flavour. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: बदाम, तिल, सुकेको नरिवल र धनियाँको दाना भुट्नुहोस्, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो र नुनसँग पिँध्नुहोस्, साना भन्टामा भर्नुहोस् र नरम नहुन्जेल तेलमा बिस्तारै पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast peanuts, sesame, dried coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, fill into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा बदाम ⟦1⟧काँचो, बोक्रासहित वा बोक्राबिना⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧अझ पिरो तरकारीका लागि 1 ठूलो चम्चासम्म⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 वटा साना भन्टा ⟦1⟧लगभग 500 g, साना, गोला, बैजनी⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small, round, purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.t: 2 ठूलो चम्चा हरियो धनियाँ ⟦1⟧काटेको, अन्त्यमा हाल्न⟦/1⟧
seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons green coriander ⟦1⟧chopped, to add at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: बदाम, तिल, नरिवल र धनियाँको दाना सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्; मसलासँग पिँध्नुहोस्। पहिले बदामलाई मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा 3–4 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्, अनि धनियाँको दाना, जीरा र तिल हालेर 1 मिनेट, र अन्तिम 30 सेकेन्डमा नरिवल हालेर हल्का सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। सेलाउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Dry-roast peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. First roast the peanuts on less than medium heat 3–4 minutes, then add coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and in the last 30 seconds add coconut and roast until light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सरमा भुटेको मिश्रणलाई लसुन, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो, नुन र इमलीसँग पानी नहाली मोटो धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्। थिच्दा डल्लो पर्नुपर्छ।
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer grind the roasted mixture with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without water to a coarse powder. When pressed it should form a lump.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: भन्टा पखाल्नुहोस् र डाँठ नछुटाई हरियो टोपी अलिकति काट्नुहोस्।
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little without removing the stem.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: हरेक भन्टालाई डाँठ नछुटाई तलबाट क्रस आकारमा चिर्नुहोस्, र भर्ने मसला भर्नुहोस्। लगभग तीन चौथाइ माथिसम्म मात्र काट्नुहोस् ताकि चारै भाग माथि जोडिएर रहून्। काट्दै जाँदा हरेकलाई नुनपानीको कचौरामा हाल्दै जानुहोस्, अनि पानी तर्काउनुहोस्।
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Slit each brinjal from the bottom in a cross shape without removing the stem, and fill with the stuffing masala. Cut only about three quarters of the way up so all four parts stay joined at the top. As you cut, put each into a bowl of salt water, then drain.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: हरेक भन्टामा लगभग 1 सानो चम्चा भरिभराउ मसला थिचेर भर्नुहोस्। बाँकी मसला छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्।
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 teaspoon of masala into each brinjal to fill it full. Keep the remaining masala aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: चौडा, बाक्लो प्यानमा मध्यम आगोमा तेल तताउनुहोस्। रायोको दाना हाल्नुहोस् र चटचटाउन थालेपछि करी पात र प्याज (प्रयोग गर्ने भए) हाल्नुहोस्। प्याजलाई नरम नहुन्जेल लगभग 3 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add mustard seeds and once they start crackling add curry leaves and onion (if using). Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: भरेका भन्टालाई प्यानमा एउटै तहमा मिलाउनुहोस्।
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Arrange the stuffed brinjals in the pan in a single layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: भन्टालाई तातो तेलमा छोपेर मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्, हरेक 4–5 मिनेटमा बिस्तारै पल्टाउँदै। मसला ननिस्कोस् भनेर चम्चा वा चिम्टाले पल्टाउनुहोस्, र बोक्रा चाउरिन्जेल 15–18 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals covered in the hot oil on low heat, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Turn with a spoon or tongs so the masala does not come out, and cook 15–18 minutes until the skin wrinkles.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: बाँकी मसला ½ कप पानीसँग हाल्नुहोस्; भन्टा नरम नहुन्जेल मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। छोपेर मन्द आगोमा अझ 8–10 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्, मसला बाक्लो भएर छेउमा तेल नदेखिउन्जेल।
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining masala with ½ cup water; cook on low heat until the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low heat 8–10 more minutes, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the edges.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: पाक्यो कि जाँच्नुहोस्: सबैभन्दा मोटो भन्टामा चक्कु कुनै अवरोधबिना छिर्नुपर्छ। हरियो धनियाँ छरेर आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्।
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check if cooked: a knife should go into the fattest brinjal without any resistance. Sprinkle green coriander and turn off the heat.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: पकाउँदा र पल्टाउँदा भन्टा नछुट्टियोस् भनेर डाँठ नहटाउनुहोस्।
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Do not remove the stem so the brinjals do not come apart while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: एकनास पाकून् भनेर उस्तै साइजका साना, चम्किला भन्टा छान्नुहोस्; ठूला भन्टा बीचमा कडै रहन्छन्।
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of the same size so they cook evenly; large brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: बदाम र तिललाई मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा भुट्नुहोस्; डढेको तिलले सम्पूर्ण मसला तितो बनाउँछ।
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast peanuts and sesame on less than medium heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: कम पिरो तरकारीका लागि 1½ सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; अझ पिरोका लागि 1 ठूलो चम्चासम्म बढाउनुहोस्।
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry use 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for hotter increase up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: प्याजको मसलासँग: अझ नरम, अलिकति गुलियो झोलका लागि भर्ने मसलामा 1 वटा सानो प्याज पिँधेर मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer, slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion and mix into the stuffing masala.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: नरिवलबिना: नरिवल नहाल्नुहोस् र 1 ठूलो चम्चा बढी बदाम र तिल प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tablespoon more peanuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: झोल भएको: भातमा मुछ्ने अलि पातलो तरकारीका लागि अन्तिम चरणमा ½ कपको सट्टा 1 कप पानी हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: With gravy: for a slightly thinner curry to mix with rice add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup in the last step.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात र एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग, वा चपाती वा जोन्न रोट्टेसँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। अलिकति पानी हालेर बिस्तारै तताउनुहोस्।
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Cover and keep in the fridge and finish within 2 days. Heat gently with a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ति वंकायका लागि कुन भन्टा सबैभन्दा राम्रो हुन्छ?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: अण्डा जत्रा साना, गोला, बैजनी भन्टा, चम्किलो बोक्रा र हरियो डाँठ भएका। मसला पाक्ने समयमै यी भित्रसम्म पाक्छन् र मसला राम्ररी समात्छन्।
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-sized small, round, purple brinjals with shiny skin and green stems. These cook through in the same time the masala cooks and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.t: भन्टा पाके कि भनेर कसरी थाहा पाउने?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know if the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: बोक्रा चाउरिन्छ र नरम हुन्छ, र सबैभन्दा मोटो भन्टामा चक्कु कुनै अवरोधबिना छिर्छ। काँचै भन्टा बीचमा कडा र स्पन्जजस्तो लाग्छ।
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skin wrinkles and becomes soft, and a knife goes into the fattest brinjal without any resistance. A raw brinjal feels hard and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can gutti vankaya be made without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: सकिन्छ। नरिवलको सट्टा 1 ठूलो चम्चा बढी बदाम र 1 ठूलो चम्चा बढी तिल प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; मसलामा बदामको स्वाद अझ बढी आउँछ।
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut use 1 tablespoon more peanuts and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala has even more peanut flavour.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals break apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: डाँठ हटाइएको थियो वा क्रस पूरै तलदेखि माथिसम्म काटिएको थियो। डाँठ नहटाउनुहोस्, माथिबाट लगभग एक चौथाइ बाँकी राखेर चिर्न रोक्नुहोस् र बिस्तारै पल्टाउनुहोस्।
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem was removed or the cross was cut all the way from bottom to top. Do not remove the stem, stop slitting leaving about a quarter from the top, and turn gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · गुत्ति वंकाय कुराको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. भुटेको बदाम, तिल र नरिवललाई सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र बेसार धुलोसँग पिँधेर भरिएका साना भन्टा, तेलमा बिस्तारै पकाइएका।
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanuts, sesame and coconut ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked slowly in oil.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कुरा (आन्ध्रको भरेको भन्टाको तरकारी) · 1acrefarms
seg.e6d2d516a538.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra stuffed brinjal curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ति वंकाय कुरा: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Kura: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि भनेको आन्ध्रका मिठाई पसल र घरहरूमा चिया, चाडपर्व र पाहुनाका लागि तारिने काजुको पकौडा हो: बेसन र चामलको पिठोको पातलो, मसलेदार लेपमा साबुत काजु, कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल तारिएका। प्याज नहाली बनाइने भएकाले यो बट्टामा धेरै दिन टिक्छ, त्यसैले धेरै घरमा दिवाली र संक्रान्तिमा आउने पाहुनाका लागि एक खेप तारिन्छ।
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakora fried in Andhra sweet shops and homes for tea, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spicy coating of besan and rice flour, fried until crisp. Because it is made without onion it keeps many days in a tin, so many homes fry a batch for guests coming at Diwali and Sankranti.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: हाम्रो जीडिपप्पु प्याकका साबुत काजु लेपभित्र कुरकुरे रहन्छन्, र सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले मध्यम पिरो र न्यानो रातो रङ दिन्छ। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: जम्मा समयमा पकोडि सेलाएर कुरकुरे हुने 5 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and get crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: साबुत काजुलाई बेसन, चामलको पिठो, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो, नुन र एक चम्चा तातो तेलसँग मिसाउनुहोस्, लेप लाग्ने जति मात्र पानी छर्कनुहोस्, र सुनौलो र कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल प्रशस्त तेलमा तार्नुहोस्।
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Mix whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle only enough water for the coating to stick, and deep-fry in plenty of oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप साबुत काजु ⟦1⟧लगभग 150 g; धेरै ठूला भए आधा फोड्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; if very large split in half⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧चनाको पिठो, लगभग 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 ठूलो चम्चा चामलको पिठो ⟦1⟧अझ कुरकुरे लेपका लागि⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧मध्यम पिरो; अझ पिरो पकोडिका लागि ½ सानो चम्चा थप⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; ½ teaspoon more for hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 ठूलो चम्चा तातो तेल ⟦1⟧तार्ने तेलबाटै लिएको⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil itself⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧
seg.a24adfc46507.back: 2–3 tablespoons water ⟦1⟧sprinkled a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.t: प्रशस्त तेलमा तार्न तेल ⟦1⟧प्रायः बदामको तेल प्रयोग हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for deep-frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजुलाई पखालेर राम्ररी पानी तर्काउनुहोस्; अलिकति ओसिलो सतहले पिठो टाँस्न मद्दत गर्छ।
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा तार्ने तेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat the frying oil in a kadai on medium heat.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, चामलको पिठो, खुर्सानीको धुलो, नुन, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट र करी पात मिसाउनुहोस्। चौडा कचौरा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, र सँगै हरियो खुर्सानी, हरियो धनियाँ र हिङ पनि हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and also add green chilli, green coriander and hing along with it.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 ठूलो चम्चा तातो तेल पिठोमा मिच्नुहोस्, काजु हाल्नुहोस् र पिठोले काजुलाई ढाक्ने जति मात्र पानी छर्कनुहोस्। कराहीबाट तातो तेल होसियारीसाथ चम्चाले लिनुहोस् र पहिले औंलाका टुप्पाले पिठोको मिश्रणमा मिच्नुहोस्, अनि काजु हाल्नुहोस् र एक पटकमा 1 ठूलो चम्चा पानी छर्कंदै उल्टाइपल्टाइ गर्नुहोस्, हरेक काजुमा पिठो नटाँसिउन्जेल। मिश्रण घोल होइन, ओसिलो धुलोका डल्लाजस्तो देखिनुपर्छ।
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub 1 tablespoon hot oil into the flour, add the cashews and sprinkle only enough water for the flour to coat the cashews. Carefully take hot oil from the kadai with a spoon and first rub it into the flour mixture with fingertips, then add the cashews and toss, sprinkling 1 tablespoon water at a time, until flour sticks to every cashew. The mixture should look like lumps of damp powder, not a batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तेल जाँच्नुहोस्: एक चिम्टी मिश्रण खसाल्दा 2–3 सेकेन्डमा एकनासका फोकासहित माथि आउनुपर्छ। तुरुन्तै खैरो भयो भने तेल धेरै तातो छ।
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Test the oil: a pinch of mixture dropped in should come up in 2–3 seconds with even bubbles. If it browns immediately the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: साना-साना झुप्पा मध्यम तातो तेलमा खसाल्नुहोस्। एक पटकमा लेप लागेका 3–4 वटा काजु औंलाले टिपेर कराही नखाँदी खुकुलो गरी तेलमा खसाल्नुहोस्।
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick 3–4 coated cashews at a time with fingers and drop them loosely into the oil without crowding the kadai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: पल्टाउँदै सुनौलो र कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल 5–6 मिनेट तार्नुहोस्; कागजमा तेल तर्काउनुहोस्। पाकेपछि पकोडि वरिपरिका फोका साना र ढिला हुन्छन्।
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry 5–6 minutes turning until golden and crisp; drain the oil on paper. When done the bubbles around the pakodi become small and slow.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: बाँकीलाई पनि त्यसैगरी खेप-खेप गरी तार्नुहोस्, हरेक खेपबीच तेललाई फेरि तात्न दिँदै।
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the rest the same way in batches, letting the oil heat up again between each batch.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडिलाई कागजमा 5 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्; सेलाउँदै जाँदा झन् कुरकुरे हुन्छन्। मन लागे माथिबाट एक चिम्टी नुन वा खुर्सानीको धुलो छर्नुहोस्।
seg.8ab193492427.back: Leave the pakodi on paper 5 minutes; they get even crisper as they cool. If you like sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: मिश्रण बाक्लो र सुख्खा राख्नुहोस्, पातलो होइन, नत्र पकोडि नरम हुन्छ।
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the mixture thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi turns soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्यम आगोमा तार्नुहोस्: काजु छिट्टै खैरो हुन्छ, र तेज आगोमा भित्रको काजु भुटिनुअघि नै लेपको रङ बदलिन्छ।
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown quickly, and on high heat the coating changes colour before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: पिठोमा मिचिएको एक चम्चा तातो तेलले पकोडिलाई हलुका र कुरकुरे बनाउँछ।
seg.76602f605fc8.back: A spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले मध्यम पिरो र राम्रो रातो रङ दिन्छ; बच्चाहरूका लागि ½ सानो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat and a nice red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: अझ पिरो: आधा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोको सट्टा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्, जुन निकै पिरो हुन्छ।
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: instead of half the Sannam chilli powder put Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: प्याजसँग: अझ नरम, गुलियो पकोडिका लागि काजुसँगै 1 वटा सानो प्याज पातलो काटेर हाल्नुहोस्, र त्यही दिन खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer, sweeter pakodi add 1 small thinly sliced onion along with the cashews, and finish it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदिना: हरियो धनियाँसँगै 2 ठूलो चम्चा काटेको पुदिनाको पात हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves along with the green coriander.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: साँझको चिया वा फिल्टर कफीसँग मनतातो पस्कनुहोस्। यो टिफिन बक्समा वा भात-पप्पुको खानासँग साइडमा पनि राख्न मिल्छ।
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve lukewarm with evening tea or filter coffee. It can also go in a tiffin box or on the side with a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पूरै सेलाएपछि हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा कोठाको तापक्रममा राख्नुहोस् र 4–5 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। नरम भए सुख्खा प्यानमा मन्द आगोमा 2–3 मिनेट तताउनुहोस्।
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling fully keep in an airtight tin at room temperature and finish within 4–5 days. If it goes soft heat in a dry pan on low heat 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: मेरो काजुको पकोडि किन नरम भयो?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: पिठोमा धेरै पानी हालेर, वा मन्द आगोमा तारेर। मिश्रणलाई ओसिलो धुलोका डल्लाजस्तो राख्नुहोस् र फोका ढिला नहुन्जेल मध्यम आगोमा तार्नुहोस्।
seg.346050614d3a.back: From adding too much water to the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mixture like lumps of damp powder and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should the cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: भिजाउनु पर्दैन। पिठो टाँसोस् भनेर छिटो पखाल्नु नै पर्याप्त छ; धेरै बेर भिजाएका काजुको कुरकुरेपन केही घट्छ।
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. A quick wash is enough for the flour to stick; cashews soaked a long time lose some of their crunch.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: चामलको पिठोबिना काजुको पकोडि बनाउन सकिन्छ?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can cashew pakodi be made without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: सकिन्छ। 2 ठूलो चम्चा बढी बेसन, वा 1 ठूलो चम्चा कर्नफ्लोर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। चामलको पिठोले सबैभन्दा कुरकुरे लेप दिन्छ, त्यसैले यसबिना पकोडि अलि नरम हुन्छ।
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 tablespoons more besan, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi is slightly softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: काजुको पकोडि कति दिन कुरकुरे रहन्छ?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How many days does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा लगभग 4–5 दिन, बट्टामा राख्नुअघि पूरै सेलाएको छ भने।
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight tin, if it has cooled fully before going in the tin.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. हाम्रो जीडिपप्पु प्याकका साबुत काजु, बेसन, चामलको पिठो र सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोबाट बनेको कुरकुरे काजुको पकोडि। चरणबद्ध विधि, सुझाव र प्रायः सोधिने प्रश्नहरू।
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crispy cashew pakodi made from whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडि: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा आन्ध्रको दैनिक नास्ता हो: प्याज, हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पातको तड्का लगाइएको पानीमा नरम पकाइएको सुजी। जीडिपप्पु उप्मा यसको सजिएको रूप हो, घ्यूमा सुनौलो भुटेको एक मुठी काजुसहित, जसरी पाहुना, चाडको बिहान र बिहेमा बनाइन्छ, प्रायः पेसरट्टुसँग वा एक चम्चा चिनीसँग पस्किन्छ।
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's daily breakfast: semolina cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chilli and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its dressed-up form, with a handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as made for guests, festival mornings and weddings, usually served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: हाम्रो जीडिपप्पु काजु साबुत र सादा छन्, त्यसैले एकनास भुटिन्छन् र नरम सुजीसँग कुरकुरे रहन्छन्। लगभग 25 मिनेटमा खाना तयार हुन्छ। यो रेसिपी 3 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they roast evenly and stay crunchy with the soft semolina. The food is ready in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: सुजी भुट्नुहोस्, घ्यूमा काजु भुट्नुहोस्, अनि तड्का लगाएर प्याज र खुर्सानी नरम पार्नुहोस्। नुन हालेर पानी उमाल्नुहोस्, सुजी हालेर चलाउनुहोस्, छोप्नुहोस् र अन्त्यमा काजु हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the semolina, fry the cashews in ghee, then temper and soften the onion and chilli. Boil water with salt, add the semolina and stir, cover and add the cashews at the end.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बम्बै रवा ⟦1⟧मझौला सुजी, लगभग 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina, about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ कप पानी ⟦1⟧अलि कडा उपमाका लागि 2 कप⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧2 cups for a slightly firmer upma⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप काजु ⟦1⟧साबुत वा आधा फोडेको, लगभग 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or split in half, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा घ्यू ⟦1⟧वा 2 ठूलो चम्चा तेल र 1 ठूलो चम्चा घ्यू⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 वटा हरियो खुर्सानी ⟦1⟧बीचमा चिरेको; अझ पिरो उपमाका लागि 3 वटा⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit in the middle; 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧

seg.46ba774a4c39.t: 2 ठूलो चम्चा हरियो धनियाँ ⟦1⟧काटेको, चाहे मात्र⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: प्याज, अदुवा र हरियो धनियाँ काट्नुहोस्, हरियो खुर्सानी चिर्नुहोस्, र पानी नापेर राख्नुहोस्।
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop the onion, ginger and green coriander, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: सुख्खा प्यानमा सुजीलाई भुटेको बास्ना नआउन्जेल लगभग 5 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्। रङ फिक्कै राख्नुहोस्। मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा लगातार चलाउनुहोस्, अनि थालमा खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the semolina in a dry pan about 5 minutes until a roasted aroma comes. Keep the colour pale. Stir constantly on less than medium heat, then pour onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: चौडा, बाक्लो प्यानमा मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा घ्यू तताउनुहोस्।
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy pan on less than medium heat.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: घ्यूमा काजुलाई सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; निकालेर राख्नुहोस्। यसमा लगभग 1–2 मिनेट लाग्छ; घ्यू प्यानमै राख्नुहोस्।
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry the cashews in the ghee until golden; take out and keep. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: रायो, दाल र करी पातको तड्का लगाउनुहोस्। प्याज र खुर्सानी नरम पार्नुहोस्, पानी र नुन हालेर उमाल्नुहोस्। करी पात हाल्नुअघि रायोको दाना चटचटाउन र दाल हल्का सुनौलो हुन दिनुहोस्, अनि प्याजसँगै अदुवा हालेर प्याज नरम नहुन्जेल 3–4 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Temper mustard, dal and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chilli, add water and salt and boil. Let the mustard seeds crackle and the dal turn light golden before adding curry leaves, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: पानी उम्लिएपछि चाख्नुहोस्; अलि नुनिलो लाग्नुपर्छ, किनकि सुजीले नुन सोस्छ।
seg.be01d433ae80.back: Taste after the water boils; it should taste slightly salty, because the semolina absorbs salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: आगो मन्द गर्नुहोस्। चलाउँदै सुजी पातलो धारोमा खन्याउनुहोस्। मन्द आगोमा 3 मिनेट छोपेर राख्नुहोस्; माथि काजु राख्नुहोस्।
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the heat. Pour the semolina in a thin stream while stirring. Keep covered on low heat 3 minutes; put the cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजु हाल्नुअघि उपमा जाँच्नुहोस्: सुजी नरम हुनुपर्छ, कुनै कडा दाना नभएको, र उपमाले प्यानको छेउ छोड्नुपर्छ। अझै दानेदार छ भने 2 ठूलो चम्चा तातो पानी छर्कनुहोस्, छोप्नुहोस् र अझ 1 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding cashews: the semolina should be soft, with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If still grainy sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: थप एक चम्चा घ्यू र प्रयोग गर्ने भए हरियो धनियाँ, धेरैजसो काजुसँगै हालेर चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Add an extra spoon of ghee and green coriander if using, along with most of the cashews, and stir.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: माथि बाँकी काजु राखेर तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.351e9512c914.back: Serve hot with the remaining cashews on top.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: डल्ला नपरून् भनेर चलाउँदै सुजी पातलो धारोमा खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Pour the semolina in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: पहिले सुजी भुट्दा हरेक दाना छुट्टै रहन्छ; नभुटे उपमा टाँसिने हुन्छ।
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting the semolina first keeps each grain separate; without roasting the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजुलाई मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा भुट्नुहोस् र सुनौलो हुनेबित्तिकै निकाल्नुहोस्; तातो घ्यूमा ती झन्झन् गाढा हुँदै जान्छन्।
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry the cashews on less than medium heat and take them out as soon as they are golden; in hot ghee they keep getting darker.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: राखिराख्दा उपमा कडा हुन्छ, त्यसैले तपाईंलाई चाहिएभन्दा अलि नरम छँदै आगोबाट झार्नुहोस्।
seg.975560a8a158.back: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat while it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: तरकारी उपमा: प्याजसँगै ½ कप काटेको गाजर, सिमी र हरियो केराउ हाल्नुहोस् र पानी हाल्नुअघि 3–4 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas along with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: गोलभेडा उपमा: प्याजपछि 1 वटा काटेको गोलभेडा हाल्नुहोस् र पानी हाल्नुअघि नरम नहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुम रवा उपमा: त्यति नै गहुँको रवा 3 कप पानीसँग प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र छोपेर 5–6 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: बिहानको नास्ताको रूपमा नरिवलको चटनी, अल्लम पच्चडि वा एक चम्चा चिनीसँग, वा पेसरट्टु उप्माका लागि पेसरट्टुसँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.01300d94ad36.back: As breakfast serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or with pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमा बनाएपछि तुरुन्तै तातै खानु सबैभन्दा राम्रो हुन्छ। बचेको उपमा छोपेर फ्रिजमा 1 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस् र फेरि तताउनुअघि पानी छर्कनुहोस्।
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Upma is best eaten hot immediately after making. Cover leftover upma and keep in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: पानी उम्लिरहेकै राख्नुहोस्, आगो मन्द गर्नुहोस् र एक हातले सुजी पातलो धारोमा खन्याउँदै अर्को हातले चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the heat and pour the semolina in a thin stream with one hand while stirring with the other.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपमाका लागि सुजी र पानीको सही अनुपात कति हो?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of semolina and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: नरम आन्ध्र शैलीको उपमाका लागि 1 कप बम्बै रवामा 2½ कप पानी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। अलि कडा, दाना छुट्टिने उपमाका लागि 2 कप।
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma use 2½ cups water to 1 cup Bombay rava. For a slightly firmer upma with separate grains, 2 cups.

seg.2cc94b02b5b4.back: Why did my upma turn sticky?

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
