seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: सुजी भुटिएको थिएन, वा धेरै पानी पर्यो। भुटेको बास्ना नआउन्जेल सुजी भुट्नुहोस्, र प्रति कप 2½ कपको नजिक पानी राख्नुहोस्।
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The semolina was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the semolina until a roasted aroma comes, and keep the water close to 2½ cups per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When to add the cashews to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: पहिले घ्यूमा भुटेर निकाल्नुहोस्, अनि अन्त्यमा मिसाउनुहोस्। चाँडै हाले उपमामा ती नरम हुन्छन्।
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry in ghee and take out, then mix in at the end. If added early they go soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. घ्यूमा सुनौलो भुटेका जीडिपप्पु काजुसहितको आन्ध्रको सुजी उपमा, नरम र छिटो बन्ने बिहानको नास्ता। चरणबद्ध विधि, सुझाव र प्रायः सोधिने प्रश्नहरू। 3 जनालाई।
seg.8b57b24af158.back: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra semolina upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उप्मा: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडि वेपुडु भनेको आन्ध्रको सुख्खा चिकन फ्राइ हो: कुखुराको मासुका साना टुक्रा आफ्नै रसमा पकाइन्छन्, अनि करी पात, हरियो खुर्सानी र भर्खरै भुटेको मसलासँग तेलमा कडा गरी भुटिन्छन्, गाढा रङ भएर मसला टाँसिन्जेल। यो आन्ध्रका बिहेमा सुरुमा पस्किने परिकार हो, र घरमा रसम-भात वा पप्पुसँग साइडमा राखिन्छ।
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken are cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chilli and freshly roasted spices, until dark in colour and the masala clings. It is the dish served first at Andhra weddings, and at home it is kept on the side with rasam-rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: हाम्रो तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोले यसलाई गाढा रातो रङ र आन्ध्रका फ्राइ चिनिने पिरोपन दिन्छ, हाम्रो बेसार धुलो मसलामा जान्छ, र हाम्रा साबुत काजु सुनौलो भुटेर अन्त्यमा हालिन्छन्। साइडको रूपमा 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.db90598234ea.back: Our Teja chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashews are fried golden and added at the end. As a side it serves 4 people.

seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: कुखुराको मासुलाई तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट र कागतीमा मोलेर राख्नुहोस्, आफ्नै रसमा पकाउनुहोस्, अनि करी पात, हरियो खुर्सानी, भुटेको मसला र काजुसँग सुख्खा हुनेगरी भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juices, then fry dry with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted spices and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g हड्डीबिनाको कुखुराको मासु ⟦1⟧1 इन्चका टुक्रामा काटेको; वा 600 g हड्डीसहितका साना टुक्रा⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 वटा काजु ⟦1⟧साबुत काजु; ठूला भए आधा फोड्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashews; if large split in half⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.t: 2 डाँठ करी पात ⟦1⟧पात टिपेको, लगभग 30 वटा⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: मसला टाँसोस् भनेर कुखुराको मासुलाई कपडाले थपथपाएर सुकाउनुहोस्।
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the masala sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: कुखुराको मासुलाई तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार, अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट, कागतीको रस र नुनमा 30 मिनेट मोलेर राख्नुहोस्। हरेक टुक्रामा मसला लागोस् भनेर हातले राम्ररी मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken 30 minutes in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt. Mix well by hand so every piece gets masala.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: यसबीच, सानो प्यानमा मन्द आगोमा धनियाँको दाना, जीरा, सौँफ, ल्वाङ र दालचिनीलाई बास्ना आएर एक रङ गाढा नहुन्जेल लगभग 2 मिनेट सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्। सेलाएर मोटो धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्। यही फ्राइ मसला हो।
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, in a small pan on low heat dry-roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon about 2 minutes until aromatic and one shade darker. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: कुखुराको मासुलाई पानी नहाली बाक्लो कराहीमा राख्नुहोस्, छोप्नुहोस् र मध्यम आगोमा बसाल्नुहोस्।
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai without adding water, cover and set on medium heat.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: छोपेर आफ्नै रसमा कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहुन्जेल लगभग 12 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्। एक-दुई पटक चलाउनुहोस्; पाक्दै जाँदा मासुले पानी छोड्छ।
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook covered in its own juices about 12 minutes until no pink colour remains anywhere. Stir once or twice; the meat releases water as it cooks.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: खोलेर तेज आगोमा चलाउँदै रस लगभग सुकुन्जेल 3–4 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्। मासुलाई थालमा खन्याउनुहोस् र कराही पुछ्नुहोस्।
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Uncover and cook on high heat stirring 3–4 minutes until the juices have almost dried. Tip the meat onto a plate and wipe the kadai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadai on medium heat.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: तेलमा काजु सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; निकाल्नुहोस्। यसमा एक मिनेटभन्दा कम लाग्छ, त्यसैले लगातार चलाउनुहोस् र प्वाल भएको चम्चाले निकाल्नुहोस्।
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take out. This takes less than a minute, so stir constantly and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: प्रयोग गर्ने भए प्याज हालेर सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पात भुट्नुहोस्। अलि पर उभिनुहोस्; पात चटचटाउँछन् र तेल छिट्छ।
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If using, add the onion and fry until golden. Fry green chilli and curry leaves. Stand a little back; the leaves crackle and the oil splatters.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: कुखुराको मासु र फ्राइ मसला हाल्नुहोस्। सुख्खा र गाढा नहुन्जेल तेज आगोमा भुट्नुहोस्, अनि काजु हालेर उल्टाइपल्टाइ गर्नुहोस्। मसला टुक्रामा टाँसिएर किनारा गाढा र कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल 6–8 मिनेट उल्टाइपल्टाइ गरिरहनुहोस्।
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high heat until dry and dark, then add the cashews and toss. Keep tossing 6–8 minutes until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges are dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: चाख्नुहोस्, चाहिए नुन थप्नुहोस्, हरियो धनियाँ छरेर तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle green coriander and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: हरेक टुक्रामा मसला टाँसोस् भनेर अन्त्यमा तेज आगोमा भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.349c72ce839a.back: Fry on high heat at the end so the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो धेरै पिरो हुन्छ। मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, वा कम पिरोसहित रातो रङका लागि त्यसको सट्टा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour with less heat put Sannam chilli powder instead.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: टुक्रा साना र एकनासका काट्नुहोस् ताकि सबै एकैसाथ भित्रसम्म पाकून् र फ्राइमा राम्ररी कुरकुरे होऊन्।
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and even so they all cook through at the same time and get nicely crisp in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: पकाउनुभन्दा ठीक अघि मात्र फ्राइ मसला पिँध्नुहोस्; भुटेको मसलाको बास्ना नै राम्रो वेपुडुको प्राण हो।
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala only just before cooking; the aroma of the roasted spices is the soul of a good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: हड्डीसहित: 600 g हड्डीसहितका साना टुक्रा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र हड्डी नजिक कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहुन्जेल आफ्नै रसमा 18–20 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook in their own juices 18–20 minutes until no pink colour remains anywhere near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरि वेपुडु: फ्राइमा मसलासँगै 3 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको सुकेको नरिवल हाल्नुहोस् र खैरो नहुन्जेल उल्टाइपल्टाइ गर्नुहोस्।
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tablespoons grated dried coconut with the masala in the fry and toss until brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g हड्डीबिनाको खसीको मासुलाई मसला र ½ कप पानीसँग 5–6 सिट्ठीसम्म प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्, अनि त्यसैगरी भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: pressure cook 500 g boneless goat meat with the masala and ½ cup water up to 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम-भात, पप्पु-भात वा साम्बर-भातसँग साइडको रूपमा, वा काटेको प्याज र कागतीका चोक्टासँग सुरुमा खाने परिकारको रूपमा तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot as a side with rasam-rice, pappu-rice or sambar-rice, or as a starter with chopped onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: छोपेर फ्रिजमा 2 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस्। केही थोपा तेल हालेर तातो प्यानमा भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तताउनुहोस्; यो फेरि कुरकुरे हुन्छ।
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Cover and keep in the fridge up to 2 days. Heat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until it steams right through; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आन्ध्रमा चिकन फ्राइ र चिकन करीमा के फरक छ?
seg.551573b4b443.back: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु सुख्खा हुन्छ: मासु आफ्नै रसमा पकाइन्छ, अनि झोलबिना मसलाले ढाक्ने गरी भुटिन्छ। कोडि कुरा भातसँग खाने प्याज-गोलभेडाको झोल भएको करी हो।
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: the meat is cooked in its own juices, then fried without gravy so the masala coats it. Kodi kura is a curry with onion-tomato gravy eaten with rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडुका लागि हड्डीबिनाको मासु प्रयोग गर्ने कि हड्डीसहितको?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should boneless or bone-in meat be used for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: दुवै चल्छन्। हड्डीबिनाको मासु छिटो पाक्छ र बढी कुरकुरे हुन्छ; हड्डीसहितका साना टुक्रामा स्वाद बढी हुन्छ तर आफ्नै रसमा लगभग 8 मिनेट बढी पकाउनुपर्छ।
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless meat cooks faster and gets crisper; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their own juices.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: सबैभन्दा बाक्लो टुक्रा काटेर हेर्नुहोस्। बीचमा (वा हड्डी नजिक) कतै गुलाबी रङ बाँकी नरहेपछि र रस सफा निस्केपछि मासु पाकेको हुन्छ।
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut open the thickest piece and look. The meat is cooked once no pink colour remains anywhere in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice runs clear.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडि वेपुडु कम पिरो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, वा त्यसको सट्टा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्, र 2 वटा मात्र हरियो खुर्सानी चिर्नुहोस्। काजु र करी पातले स्वाद भरिलो राख्छन्।
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or put Sannam chilli powder instead, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour rich.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: కోడి వేపుడు · कोडि वेपुडु (आन्ध्रको चिकन फ्राइ) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: కోడి వేపుడు. आन्ध्रको चिकन फ्राइ: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र बेसार धुलोमा राखिएको कुखुराको मासु, करी पात, हरियो खुर्सानी, भुटेको मसला र हाम्रा काजुसँग सुख्खा भुटिएको।
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chilli, roasted spices and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडि वेपुडु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा भनेको आन्ध्रका घरहरूको चम्किलो पहेँलो कागती भात हो: पकाएको भातमा बदाम, चनाको दाल, मासको दाल, रायोको दाना, हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पातको चटचटाउँदो तड्का मिसाइन्छ, अनि कागतीको रसले अमिलो बनाइन्छ। रेल यात्रा, स्कुलको टिफिन बक्स र मन्दिर जाने दिनका लागि यही भात पोको पारिन्छ, र चाडपर्व र पूजाका लागि ठूलो मात्रामा बनाइन्छ।
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice is mixed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chilli and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. This rice is packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and made in large quantity for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: हाम्रो बेसार धुलो केही सेकेन्ड तातो तेलमा जान्छ, जसले हरेक दानालाई एकनास सुनौलो पहेँलो बनाउँछ र यसको काँचो स्वाद हटाउँछ। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into hot oil for a few seconds, which makes every grain an even golden yellow and removes its raw taste. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: जम्मा समयमा भात पकाउने र स्वाद मिलोस् भनेर 15 मिनेट छोड्ने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time also includes cooking the rice and 15 minutes of resting so the flavours blend.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: बदाम, दाल, रायोको दाना, खुर्सानी र करी पात तेलमा भुट्नुहोस्, बेसार धुलो र हिङ हाल्नुहोस्, अनि सेलाएको भात, नुन र कागतीको रससँग मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry peanuts, dal, mustard seeds, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then mix with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप चामल ⟦1⟧सोना मसुरी, लगभग 200 g; पकाएपछि लगभग 3 कप हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; after cooking it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप पकाएको भात ⟦1⟧अलि कडा पकाएको, दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked slightly firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा कागतीको रस ⟦1⟧लगभग 2 वटा कागतीबाट; स्वादअनुसार थप⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; more to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा तेल ⟦1⟧प्रायः बदामको तेल प्रयोग हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: चामल पखालेर 2 कप पानीमा भर्खरै पाक्ने गरी पकाउनुहोस्, ताकि दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै रहून्। लगभग 3 कप पकाएको भात चाहिन्छ।
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook in 2 cups water just until done, so the grains stay separate. About 3 cups of cooked rice is needed.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: पकाएको भात सेलाउन थालमा फिँजाउनुहोस्; नुन हाल्नुहोस्। काँटाले फुकाउनुहोस् र तातो होइन, मनतातो नहुन्जेल लगभग 10 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्, ताकि मिसाउँदा दाना नभाँचिऊन्।
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Fluff with a fork and leave about 10 minutes until lukewarm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तेल तताउनुहोस्; बदाम, दाल, रायोको दाना, खुर्सानी र करी पात भुट्नुहोस्। पहिले बदामलाई मध्यम आगोमा चटचटाएर बोक्रा गाढा नहुन्जेल लगभग 2 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry peanuts, dal, mustard seeds, chilli and curry leaves. First fry the peanuts on medium heat about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: चनाको दाल र मासको दाल हालेर हल्का सुनौलो नहुन्जेल लगभग 1 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry about 1 minute until light golden.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: रायोको दाना हालेर चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्, अनि सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी, हरियो खुर्सानी, अदुवा र करी पात हालेर पात कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल केही सेकेन्ड भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard seeds and let them crackle, then add dried red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves are crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: बेसार धुलो र हिङ हालेर चलाउनुहोस्; आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्। बेसार नडढी तातो तेलमा पाकोस् भनेर 5–10 सेकेन्ड मात्र चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.6e856356980b.back: Add turmeric powder and hing and stir; turn off the heat. Stir only 5–10 seconds so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: भातमाथि खन्याउनुहोस्, कागतीको रस हालेर बिस्तारै मिसाउनुहोस्। औंला वा चेप्टो पन्यूले तलबाट भात उचाल्दै मिसाउनुहोस्, ताकि हरेक दाना पहेँलो होस् तर भात नगलोस्।
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. Mix by lifting the rice from below with fingers or a flat spatula, so every grain turns yellow but the rice does not go mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: चाखेर चाहिए अझ नुन वा कागतीको रस हाल्नुहोस्। भात प्रस्टै अमिलो र नुनिलो लाग्नुपर्छ, किनकि राखिराख्दा स्वाद नरम हुन्छ।
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because the flavour softens as it stands.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: भातले कागती र तड्का सोसोस् भनेर पस्कनुअघि पुलिहोरालाई छोपेर 15 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Leave the pulihora covered 15 minutes before serving so the rice absorbs the lemon and tempering.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: कागतीको रस तीखो रहोस् भनेर आगोबाट हटाएपछि हाल्नुहोस्। पकाएको कागतीको रस तितो हुन्छ।
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice after removing from the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: भात अलि कडा पकाउनुहोस् र मिसाउनुअघि सेलाउन दिनुहोस्; तातो, नरम भात लेदो हुन्छ।
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns mushy.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: बेसार धुलोलाई तेलमा केही सेकेन्ड मात्र राख्नुहोस्; डढेको बेसारले गाढा रङ र तितो स्वाद दिन्छ।
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and bitter taste.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: बिहानको बचेको भात राम्रो हुन्छ, किनकि दाना पहिल्यै कडा र छुट्टाछुट्टै हुन्छन्।
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover rice from the morning is good, because the grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजु: चाडको पुलिहोराका लागि बदामसँगै 10 वटा आधा काजु भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 half cashews along with the peanuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाय पुलिहोरा: कागतीको रसको सट्टा तड्कासँग 1 कप कोरेको काँचो आँप मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: कोरेको नरिवल: अलि हल्का स्वादको भातका लागि कागतीको रससँगै 2 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको नरिवल हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a slightly milder-flavoured rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut along with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: कोठाको तापक्रममा दही, अचार वा अप्पडमसँग पस्कनुहोस्। यो टिफिन बक्स र यात्राको चर्चित भात हो।
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with yogurt, pickle or appadam. It is the famous rice of tiffin boxes and travel.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: यो कोठाको तापक्रममा लगभग 6 घण्टा राम्रोसँग टिक्छ, त्यसैले यात्रामा लगिन्छ। बचेको भात छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र एक दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It keeps well about 6 hours at room temperature, so it is taken on journeys. Cover leftover rice and keep in the fridge and finish within one day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: मेरो कागती भात किन तितो भयो?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why did my lemon rice turn bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: कि कागतीको रस पकाइयो, कि बेसार तेलमा डढ्यो। बेसार हाल्नुअघि चुलो बन्द गर्नुहोस्, र कागतीको रस आगोबाट हटाएर भातमा मात्र हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice was cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the stove before adding turmeric, and add lemon juice only to the rice after removing from the heat.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा र कागती भातमा के फरक छ?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा अमिलो पारिएको भातको तेलुगु नाम हो। चिन्तपण्डु पुलिहोरा इमलीको लेदोले अमिलो पारिन्छ; निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा कागतीवाला हो, छिटो बन्ने र रङ अलि हल्का।
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon one, quicker to make and slightly lighter in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: कागती भात लेदो हुनबाट कसरी जोगाउने?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: How to keep lemon rice from going mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: कम पानीमा भात अलि कडा पकाउनुहोस्, थालमा सेलाउनुहोस्, र थिच्नुको सट्टा तलबाट उचाल्दै बिस्तारै मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice slightly firm in less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.t: 3 कप भातका लागि कति कागतीको रस चाहिन्छ?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice is needed for 3 cups of rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: लगभग 3 ठूलो चम्चा, 2 वटा मझौला कागतीको रस। बिस्तारै हाल्दै चाख्नुहोस्, किनकि कागतीको अमिलोपन फरक-फरक हुन्छ।
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly while tasting, because lemons differ in sourness.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. आन्ध्रको कागती भात: सेलाएको भातमा बदाम र दालको तड्का, हाम्रो बेसार धुलो र कागतीको रस मिसाइएको। चरणबद्ध विधि, सुझाव र प्रायः सोधिने प्रश्नहरू।
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice mixed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाय पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.bea68001f34a.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Pasupu Annam · Haldi wale chawal (turmeric rice)

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम भनेको बेसारले चम्किलो पहेँलो बनाइएको सादा भात हो, जसमा रायोको दाना, चनाको दाल, करी पात र हरियो खुर्सानीको चटचटाउँदो तड्का मिसाइन्छ र माथि भुटेका काजु राखिन्छन्। आन्ध्रका घरहरूमा यो टिफिन बक्स, हप्ताको छिटो खाना र पूजाको दिन प्रसादका लागि बनाइन्छ, प्रायः बिहानको बचेको भातबाट।
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric, into which a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chilli is mixed and fried cashews are put on top. In Andhra homes it is made for tiffin boxes, quick weekday meals and as prasad on puja days, often from leftover rice from the morning.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: हाम्रो पहाडी बेसार धुलो (कोंडा पसुपु) ले भातलाई गाढा पहेँलो रङ र माटोजस्तो बेसारको बास्ना दिन्छ, त्यसैले 4 जनाका लागि आधा सानो चम्चा पुग्छ। त्यही तेलमा भुटेका साबुत काजु (जीडिपप्पु) ले कुरकुरेपन थप्छन्।
seg.510252086556.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) gives the rice a deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric aroma, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4 people. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: जम्मा समयमा पकाएको भात सेलाउने लगभग 15 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time also includes about 15 minutes of cooling the cooked rice.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: भात पकाएर सेलाउन दिनुहोस्। काजु, रायोको दाना, चनाको दाल, खुर्सानी र करी पात तेलमा भुट्नुहोस्, पहाडी बेसार धुलो हाल्नुहोस् र भात मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and mix in the rice.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप चामल ⟦1⟧सोना मसुरी, लगभग 200 g; पकाएपछि लगभग 3 कप हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri, about 200 g; after cooking it becomes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ सानो चम्चा पहाडी बेसार धुलो ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (optional only) ⟦1⟧to mix in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै रहने गरी भात पकाउनुहोस्, अनि सेलाउन थालमा फिँजाउनुहोस्। भाँडो वा प्रेसर कुकरमा (2 सिट्ठी) 1 कप चामलमा 2 कप पानी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, र फिँजाउनुअघि काँटाले फुकाउनुहोस्।
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) use 2 cups water for 1 cup rice, and fluff with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: भातलाई मनतातो मात्र नहुन्जेल लगभग 15 मिनेट सेलाउन दिनुहोस्। माथिबाट नुन छर्नुहोस्।
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes until only lukewarm. Sprinkle salt on top.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: चौडा कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा तेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: तेलमा काजु सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; निकाल्नुहोस्। रायोको दाना र चनाको दाल हाल्नुहोस्। काजुलाई थालमा राख्नुहोस्; लगभग 1 मिनेटमा ती सुनौलो हुन्छन्।
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry the cashews in the oil until golden; take out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Put the cashews on a plate; in about 1 minute they turn golden.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: रायोको दाना चटचटाउन थालेपछि मासको दाल र सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी हालेर चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: Once the mustard seeds start crackling add urad dal and dried red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: दाल सुनौलो भएपछि खुर्सानी र करी पात, अनि मन्द आगोमा बेसार हाल्नुहोस्। करी पातसँगै अदुवा र हिङ हाल्नुहोस्, र बेसारलाई 5–10 सेकेन्ड मात्र चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.2688182af66a.back: Once the dal is golden add chilli and curry leaves, then turmeric on low heat. Add ginger and hing along with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: बेसार नडढोस् भनेर तुरुन्तै आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्।
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the heat immediately so the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: भात, काजु र नुन हालेर एकनास पहेँलो नहुन्जेल बिस्तारै मिसाउनुहोस्। दाना नभाँचिऊन् भनेर चेप्टो पन्यूले थिच्नुको सट्टा उचाल्दै पल्टाउँदै मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add the rice, cashews and salt and mix gently until evenly yellow. So the grains do not break, mix with a flat spatula by lifting and turning instead of pressing.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: नुन चाख्नुहोस्, प्रयोग गर्ने भए घ्यू मिसाउनुहोस्, र भातले तड्का सोसोस् भनेर पस्कनुअघि छोपेर 5 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्।
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, mix in ghee if using, and before serving leave covered 5 minutes so the rice absorbs the tempering.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: दाना नभाँचिऊन् भनेर पहिले भात फिँजाएर सेलाउनुहोस्।
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: Spread and cool the rice first so the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: बेसार मन्द आगोमा हाल्नुहोस् र केही सेकेन्ड मात्र चलाउनुहोस्; डढेको बेसारले भात तितो बनाउँछ।
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low heat and stir only a few seconds; burnt turmeric makes the rice bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: पहाडी बेसार धुलोले गाढा रङ दिन्छ; 1 कप चामलका लागि ½ सानो चम्चाबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस् र अझ गाढा पहेँलो चाहिए मात्र एक चिम्टी थप्नुहोस्।
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and add a pinch only if you want a deeper yellow.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै छन् भने बिहानको बचेको भात राम्रो हुन्छ।
seg.505872469eb9.back: Leftover rice from the morning is good if the grains are separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: बेसार धुलो: हाम्रो दैनिक प्रयोगको पसुपु बेसार धुलो पनि त्यसैगरी काम गर्छ; त्यही ½ सानो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: बदाम: अझ कुरकुरेपनका लागि काजुअघि तेलमा 2 ठूलो चम्चा काँचो बदाम भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Peanuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: कागती: अमिलो, पुलिहोराजस्तो भातका लागि भातसँगै आधा कागतीको रस निचोर्नुहोस्।
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a sour, pulihora-like rice squeeze the juice of half a lemon along with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: नरिवल: भातसँगै 2 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको नरिवल मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: mix 2 tablespoons grated coconut along with the rice.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: मनतातो वा कोठाको तापक्रममा दही, अप्पडलु वा सुख्खा आलुको भुटुवासँग पस्कनुहोस्। यो टिफिन बक्स र यात्राका लागि पनि राम्रोसँग पोको पार्न मिल्छ।
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with yogurt, appadalu or dry potato bhutuwa (fry). It also packs well for tiffin boxes and travel.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: त्यही दिन खानु सबैभन्दा राम्रो। बचेको भात छोपेर फ्रिजमा 1 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस् र अलिकति पानी छर्केर तताउनुहोस्।
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Best eaten the same day. Cover leftover rice and keep in the fridge up to 1 day and heat with a sprinkle of water.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै रहने गरी भात पकाएर सेलाउन दिनुहोस्। काजु, रायोको दाना, चनाको दाल, खुर्सानी र करी पात तेलमा भुट्नुहोस्, मन्द आगोमा बेसार हालेर केही सेकेन्ड चलाउनुहोस्, अनि नुनसँग भात मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chilli and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat and stir a few seconds, then mix in the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: बेसार भातमा कति बेसार धुलो हाल्ने?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder to put in turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप काँचो चामल (पकाएपछि लगभग 3 कप) का लागि लगभग ½ सानो चम्चा। पहाडी बेसार धुलोले गाढा रङ दिन्छ, त्यसैले कमबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस् र चाहिए एक चिम्टी थप्नुहोस्।
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups after cooking). Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour, so start with less and add a pinch if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: मेरो बेसार भात किन तितो भयो?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why did my turmeric rice turn bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: बेसार तातो तेलमा डढ्यो, वा धेरै पर्यो। मन्द आगोमा हाल्नुहोस्, केही सेकेन्ड मात्र चलाउनुहोस् र भात हाल्नुअघि आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्।
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir only a few seconds and turn off the heat before adding the rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: बचेको भातबाट पसुपु अन्नम बनाउन सकिन्छ?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can pasupu annam be made from leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: सकिन्छ। दाना छुट्टाछुट्टै भएको बचेको भात राम्रो हुन्छ। तड्कामा मिसाउनुअघि औंलाले डल्ला फुटाउनुहोस्।
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains is good. Break up the lumps with fingers before mixing into the tempering.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: పసుపు అన్నం. पसुपु अन्नम, आन्ध्रको बेसार भात: पकाएको भातमा रायो, चनाको दाल र करी पातको तड्का, पहाडी बेसार धुलो र भुटेका काजु मिसाइएको। 4 जनालाई।
seg.720281a9dc26.back: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice mixed with a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves, hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ सानो चम्चा पहाडी बेसार धुलो

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागि जावा भनेको पानीमा पकाइएको कोदोको पिठोको पिउन मिल्ने लिटो हो, जुन आन्ध्र र रायलसीमाका धेरै घरमा दैनिक पिइन्छ। नुनिलो किसिम मोहीसँग बनाइन्छ; यो गुलियो किसिम दूधले पातलो पारिन्छ र सख्खरले गुलियो बनाइन्छ, र बिहान नास्तामा वा साँझ स्टिलको टम्बलरबाट मनतातो पिइन्छ।
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a drinkable porridge of finger-millet flour cooked in water, drunk daily in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty kind is made with buttermilk; this sweet kind is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and drunk lukewarm from a steel tumbler at morning breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: हाम्रो ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खर कोदोको माटोजस्तो स्वादसँग मिल्छ र जावालाई टफीजस्तो खैरो रङ दिन्छ। सुरुदेखि अन्त्यसम्म लगभग 15 मिनेट लाग्छ। यो रेसिपी 2 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery matches the earthy taste of finger millet and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: जम्मा समयमा सख्खर हाल्नुअघि छोड्ने 2 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time also includes 2 minutes of resting before adding jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: कोदोको पिठोलाई पानीमा फिट्नुहोस्, उम्लिरहेको पानीमा बाक्लो र टल्किलो नहुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्, अनि दूध हाल्नुहोस्। आगोबाट हटाएर ताडको सख्खर र अलैंची मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk the finger-millet flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat mix in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप रागिको पिठो ⟦1⟧कोदोको पिठो, लगभग 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger-millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप पानी ⟦1⟧1 कप पिठो घोल्न, 1 कप उमाल्न⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको ताडको सख्खर ⟦1⟧लगभग 30 g; अझ गुलियो मन पर्छ भने एक चम्चा थप⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Put the finger-millet flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: कोदोको पिठोलाई 1 कप पानीमा डल्ला नरहुन्जेल चिल्लो हुनेगरी फिट्नुहोस्। फिटनी वा काँटा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र कचौराको छेउमा थिचेर डल्ला फुटाउनुहोस्।
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the finger-millet flour smooth in 1 cup water until no lumps remain. Use a whisk or fork and press against the side of the bowl to break lumps.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: बाँकी 1 कप पानी बाक्लो पिँध भएको प्यानमा खन्याएर मध्यम आगोमा बसाल्नुहोस्।
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set on medium heat.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: अर्को कप पानी उमाल्नुहोस्, कोदोको घोल खन्याउनुहोस् र मन्द आगोमा बाक्लो र टल्किलो नहुन्जेल 6–8 मिनेट चलाउनुहोस्। खन्याउनुअघि घोललाई एक पटक फेरि चलाउनुहोस्, किनकि पिठो कचौराको पिँधमा थिग्रिन्छ।
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the millet mixture and stir on low heat 6–8 minutes until thick and glossy. Stir the mixture once more before pouring, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: लगातार चलाइरहनुहोस्। धमिलो गुलाबी-खैरोबाट गाढा, टल्किलो खैरो भएर चम्चाको पछाडि लेप लाग्न थालेपछि जावा पाकेको हुन्छ।
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring constantly. The java is cooked once it goes from dull pinkish-brown to a deep, glossy brown and starts to coat the back of the spoon.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दूध हालेर 2 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। आगो बन्द गरेर 2 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्। पिँधमा नटाँसियोस् भनेर पाक्दै गर्दा एक-दुई पटक चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add milk and cook 2 minutes on low heat. Turn off the heat and leave 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while cooking so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावा छोडिराख्दा ताडको सख्खर मसिनो कोर्नुहोस्, ताकि छिटो पग्लियोस्।
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java rests grate the palm jaggery finely, so it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ताडको सख्खर र अलैंची मिसाउनुहोस्। मनतातो पस्कनुहोस्। सख्खर पूरै नपग्लिउन्जेल चलाउनुहोस्, अनि चाखेर चाहिए अलिकति थप्नुहोस्।
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Mix in palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve lukewarm. Stir until the jaggery fully melts, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: टम्बलर वा कचौरामा खन्याउनुहोस्। पिउन धेरै बाक्लो छ भने केही चम्चा मनतातो दूध मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into a tumbler or bowl. If it is too thick to drink mix in a few spoons of lukewarm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: कोदोको पिठो सधैँ पहिले पानीमा घोल्नुहोस्; सिधै उम्लिरहेको पानीमा हालेको पिठोमा नफुट्ने डल्ला पर्छन्।
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix the finger-millet flour in water first; flour put directly into boiling water forms lumps that do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: पकाउन हतार नगर्नुहोस्; राम्ररी नपाकेको कोदोको स्वाद काँचो र पिठोजस्तो हुन्छ।
seg.966098732312.back: Do not rush the cooking; under-cooked finger millet tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: टम्बलरबाट पिउने पातलो जावाका लागि 2 ठूलो चम्चा कोदोको पिठो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; चम्चाले खाने लिटोका लागि ⅓ कप।
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler use 2 tablespoons finger-millet flour; for a porridge to eat with a spoon ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: सुकेका मेवासँग: अन्त्यमा केही काटेका काजु वा बदाम (आल्मन्ड) र एक चम्चा किसमिस मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dried fruits: at the end mix in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: दूधबिना: अझ पातलो, गाढा जावाका लागि कोदोलाई 2½ कप पानीमा पकाउनुहोस् र उम्लिन छोडेपछि सख्खर मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: for a thinner, darker java cook the millet in 2½ cups water and mix in jaggery after it stops boiling.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: बिहानको नास्तामा स्टिलको टम्बलर वा कचौरामा मनतातो, वा साँझको पेयको रूपमा केही बिस्कुट वा मुरुकुलुसँग पस्कनुहोस्। कसैकसैलाई गर्मीमा चिसो पारेर मन पर्छ।
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve lukewarm in a steel tumbler or bowl at morning breakfast, or as an evening drink with some biscuits or murukulu. Some people like it chilled in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: बनाएकै दिन पिउनु सबैभन्दा राम्रो। बचेको जावा छोपेर फ्रिजमा 1 दिनसम्म राख्नुहोस्, र फेरि तताउँदा आगोबाट हटाएर अलिकति मनतातो दूध मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Best drunk the same day it is made. Cover leftover java and keep in the fridge up to 1 day, and when reheating, remove from the heat and mix in a little lukewarm milk.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: डल्ला नपरी रागि जावा कसरी बनाउने?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: पहिले कोदोको पिठोलाई कोठाको तापक्रमको पानीमा चिल्लो नहुन्जेल फिट्नुहोस्, अनि लगातार चलाउँदै यसलाई उम्लिरहेको पानीमा खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk the finger-millet flour smooth in room-temperature water, then pour it into boiling water while stirring constantly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: रागि जावा पाक्यो कि भनेर कसरी थाहा पाउने?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know if ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: यो गाढा र टल्किलो हुन्छ, चम्चाको पछाडि लेप लाग्ने जति बाक्लो हुन्छ, र पिठोजस्तो स्वाद आउँदैन। मन्द आगोमा यसमा लगभग 6–8 मिनेट लाग्छ।
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes deep and glossy, thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, and does not taste floury. On low heat this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: रागि जावामा ताडको सख्खर प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can palm jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: सकिन्छ। ताडको सख्खर (ताटि बेल्लम) मसिनो कोर्नुहोस् र दूध नफाटोस् भनेर चुलो बन्द गरेपछि मिसाउनुहोस्। यसले अझ गाढा रङ र अलिकति धुवाँजस्तो गुलियोपन दिन्छ।
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and mix in after turning off the stove so the milk does not curdle. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागि जावा र रागि माल्टमा के फरक छ?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: दुवै एउटै पेयका फरक नाम हुन्। रागि जावा तेलुगु नाम हो; पसल र मेनुमा यसलाई प्रायः रागि माल्ट भनिन्छ।
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: Both are different names for the same drink. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and menus it is usually called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: రాగి జావ · गुलियो रागि जावाको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: రాగి జావ · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: రాగి జావ. आन्ध्र शैलीको गुलियो रागि जावा: कोदोको पिठो पानीमा टल्किलो नहुन्जेल पकाइएको, दूधले पातलो पारिएको र ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खरले गुलियो बनाइएको। विधि र सुझाव।
seg.708e3c523d72.back: రాగి జావ. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: finger-millet flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागि जावा: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु भनेको मासु वा झिँगे माछालाई बाक्लो प्याजको मसलामा लगभग सुख्खा नहुन्जेल पकाउने आन्ध्रको तरिका हो, ताकि मसला हरेक टुक्रामा टाँसियोस्। रोय्यल इगुरु तटीय जिल्लाहरूबाट आउँछ, नेल्लोरदेखि गोदावरी र श्रीकाकुलमसम्म, जहाँ ब्याकवाटर र समुद्रका झिँगे माछा आइतबार दिउँसो भातसँग खाइन्छन्।
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the masala sticks to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari and Srikakulam, where prawns of the backwaters and sea are eaten with rice on Sunday afternoons.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: हाम्रो पहाडी बेसार धुलो (कोंडा पसुपु) पहिले झिँगे माछामा र अनि मसलामा जान्छ। तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोले तटीय घरहरूलाई मन पर्ने गाढा रातो रङ र कडा पिरो दिन्छ, त्यसैले आफ्नो परिवारअनुसार मात्रा मिलाउनुहोस्।
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) goes first on the prawns and then into the masala. Teja chilli powder gives the deep red colour and strong heat that coastal homes like, so adjust the amount to your family.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: तयारीमा झिँगे माछा सफा गर्ने र बेसारसँग 10 मिनेट छोड्ने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.885826f68de3.back: The prep also includes the time to clean the prawns and leave them 10 minutes with turmeric.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: झिँगे माछामा बेसार र नुन दलेर मोल्नुहोस्। प्याज र अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्ट भुट्नुहोस्, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र धनियाँको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्, अनि मसलाले ढाक्ने नहुन्जेल झिँगे माछालाई मसलामा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt into the prawns. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g झिँगे माछा ⟦1⟧मझौला साइज, बोक्रा र पिठ्यूँको कालो धागो निकालेको, सफा गरेपछि जोखेको⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black back thread removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ सानो चम्चा नुन ⟦1⟧भाग लगाएर, वा स्वादअनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ सानो चम्चा पहाडी बेसार धुलो ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; ¼ सानो चम्चा झिँगे माछाका लागि, ¼ सानो चम्चा मसलाका लागि⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧धेरै पिरो; मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा, हल्का पिरोका लागि ½ सानो चम्चा⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat 1 teaspoon, for mild heat ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: झिँगे माछाको बोक्रा र पिठ्यूँको कालो धागो निकाल्नुहोस्, राम्ररी पखाल्नुहोस् र छान्नीमा पानी तर्काउनुहोस्।
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shell and black back thread of the prawns, wash well and drain in a strainer.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: झिँगे माछामा आधा बेसार र अलिकति नुन दलेर मोल्नुहोस्; 10 मिनेट छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्। ¼ सानो चम्चा बेसार र ¼ सानो चम्चा नुन प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt into the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: बाक्लो कराहीमा मध्यम आगोमा तेल तताउनुहोस् र रायोको दाना हाल्नुहोस्। चटचटाउन थालेपछि हरियो खुर्सानी र करी पात हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add mustard seeds. Once they start crackling add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: प्याजलाई तेलमा सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, अनि अदुवा-लसुनको पेस्टलाई पाकेको बास्ना नआउन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्। प्याजलाई लगभग 8–10 मिनेट लाग्छ; पेस्टलाई काँचो गन्ध नजाउन्जेल लगभग 1 मिनेट।
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then fry the ginger-garlic paste until a cooked aroma comes. The onion takes about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: गोलभेडा प्रयोग गर्ने भए अहिले हाल्नुहोस् र नरम भएर गलुन्जेल लगभग 4 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If using tomato add it now and cook about 4 minutes until soft and melted.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: आगो मन्द गर्नुहोस्। बाँकी बेसार, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो र धनियाँको धुलो हालेर 1 मिनेट भुट्नुहोस्। बाँकी नुन हाल्नुहोस् र मसला पिँधमा नटाँसियोस् भनेर चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the heat. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder and fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the masala does not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: पानी खन्याउनुहोस् र छेउमा तेल छुट्टिन नथालुन्जेल मध्यम आगोमा मसला लगभग 3–4 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour in water and cook the masala on medium heat about 3–4 minutes until oil starts separating at the edges.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: झिँगे माछा हालेर बटारिएर गुलाबी नहुन्जेल 5–6 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्। अन्त्यमा गरम मसला हाल्नुहोस्। मसला सुकेर झिँगे माछामा लेप लागोस् भनेर मध्यमभन्दा तेज आगोमा बारम्बार चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook 5–6 minutes until curled and pink. At the end add garam masala. Stir often on medium-to-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: पाक्यो कि जाँच्नुहोस्: झिँगे माछा भित्रसम्मै गुलाबी र अपारदर्शी भएर खुकुलो C आकारमा बटारिएपछि पाकेको हुन्छ। निश्चित हुनुहुन्न भने एउटा काटेर हेर्नुहोस्; बीचमा खैरो, आरपार देखिने भाग हुनुहुँदैन।
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check if cooked: the prawns are cooked once they are pink and opaque right through and curled into a loose C shape. If not sure cut one and look; there should be no grey, see-through part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: नुन चाख्नुहोस्, हरियो धनियाँ छर्नुहोस् र आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्। झिँगे माछा पाकेपछि पकाइरहनु हुँदैन, नत्र रबरजस्तो हुन्छ।
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle green coriander and turn off the heat. Do not keep cooking the prawns after they are cooked, otherwise they turn rubbery.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा धेरै पिरो हुन्छ: 1½ सानो चम्चाले तटीय घरहरूलाई मन पर्ने जस्तो पिरो इगुरु बन्छ; मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा, वा हल्का पिरोका लागि ½ सानो चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes a hot iguru as coastal homes like it; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild heat ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: प्याजलाई राम्ररी सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; इगुरुको रङ र बाक्लोपन राम्ररी खैरो भुटेको प्याजबाट आउँछ।
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onion until well golden; the colour and thickness of the iguru come from well-browned fried onion.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: झिँगे माछा छिटो पाक्छ। खुकुलो C आकार भनेको पाक्यो; कसिलो O आकार भनेको बढी पाकेर चपाउन गाह्रो भयो।
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O shape means overcooked and hard to chew.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: पखालेपछि झिँगे माछालाई थपथपाएर सुकाउनुहोस्, ताकि पानीमा उसिनिनुको सट्टा मसलामा भुटियोस्।
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry, so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यलु: अलिकति तेलमा ओइलाएर थिचेको ½ कप गोंगुरा पात झिँगे माछासँगै मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: mix ½ cup gongura leaves wilted and pressed in a little oil along with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: नरिवल: अझ नरम, भरिलो मसलाका लागि अन्तिम 2 मिनेटमा 2 ठूलो चम्चा कोरेको नरिवल वा 3 ठूलो चम्चा बाक्लो नरिवलको दूध हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a softer, richer masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: झोल भएको: भातमाथि खन्याउने पातलो रोय्यल कुराका लागि झिँगे माछापछि ¾ कप पानी हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: With gravy: for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात र एक चम्चा घ्यूसँग, वा रसम-भात वा साम्बर-भातसँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्। चपातीसँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam-rice or sambar-rice. Also tasty with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: बचेको छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 1 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। प्यानमा बिस्तारै तताउनुहोस्; धेरै बेर तताउँदा झिँगे माछा कडा हुन्छ।
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Cover leftovers and keep in the fridge and finish within 1 day. Heat gently in a pan; heating too long makes the prawns hard.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.t: झिँगे माछा पाक्यो कि भनेर कसरी थाहा पाउने?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know if the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ती भित्रसम्मै गुलाबी र अपारदर्शी हुन्छन् र खुकुलो C आकारमा बटारिन्छन्, तातो मसलामा प्रायः 5–6 मिनेटमा। बीचमा खैरो, आरपार देखिने भाग छ भने अलि बढी पकाउनुपर्छ।
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque right through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If there is a grey, see-through part in the middle they need cooking a little more.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु र वेपुडुमा के फरक छ?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु प्याजको मसलामा बाक्लो र लगभग सुख्खा नहुन्जेल पकाइन्छ, मसला झिँगे माछामा टाँसिएको हुन्छ। वेपुडु फ्राइ हो, प्याजको झोल कम वा नभएको, झिँगे माछाका किनारा कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल पकाइएको।
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala sticking to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with little or no onion gravy, cooked until the edges of the prawns are crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्यल इगुरु कम पिरो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: मध्यम पिरोका लागि 1 सानो चम्चा वा हल्का पिरोका लागि ½ सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, र हरियो खुर्सानी नहाल्नुहोस्। अन्त्यमा एक ठूलो चम्चा दही वा नरिवलको दूधले पनि पिरो नरम पार्छ।
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ teaspoon for mild heat, and do not add green chillies. A tablespoon of yogurt or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.

seg.d024c66a11b8.t: फ्रिज गरेको झिँगे माछा प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: सकिन्छ। फ्रिजमै पगाल्नुहोस्, राम्ररी पानी तर्काउनुहोस् र बेसार र नुन दल्नुअघि थपथपाएर सुकाउनुहोस्। फ्रिज गरेको झिँगे माछाले बढी पानी छोड्छ, त्यसैले मसला अलि बढी बेर पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Thaw in the fridge itself, drain well and pat dry before rubbing in turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. रोय्यल इगुरु, तटीय आन्ध्रको झिँगे माछाको रोस्ट: पहाडी बेसार धुलो र धेरै पिरो तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोसहित प्याजको मसलामा सुख्खा नहुन्जेल पकाइएको झिँगे माछा। 4 जनालाई।
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked until dry in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and very hot Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्यल इगुरु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुण्डलु आन्ध्रका मासको दालका लड्डु हुन्: फुटेको मासको दाल भुटेको बदामजस्तो बास्ना नआउन्जेल भुटिन्छ, सख्खरसँग मसिनो पिँधिन्छ र तातो घ्यूसँग थिचेर डल्लो पारिन्छ। चासनी पकाउनु नपर्ने भएकाले लगभग आधा घण्टामा तयार हुन्छन्। आन्ध्रका घरमा संक्रान्ति र दिवालीका लागि एक बट्टा बनाइन्छ, विदेश जाने आफन्तका लागि पोको पारिन्छ, र साँझ चियासँग मिठाईका लागि राखिन्छ।
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: split urad dal is roasted until a roasted-nut aroma comes, ground fine with jaggery and pressed into balls with hot ghee. Because no syrup needs cooking they are ready in about half an hour. In Andhra homes a tin is made for Sankranti and Diwali, packed for relatives going abroad, and kept as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: हाम्रो ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खरले सुन्नुण्डलुलाई गाढा खैरो रङ र भुटेको दालसँग मिल्ने भरिलो, अलिकति धुवाँजस्तो गुलियोपन दिन्छ। यो रेसिपीले लगभग 15 वटा लड्डु बन्छन्।
seg.e564344550cd.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that matches the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: जम्मा समयमा पिँध्नुअघि भुटेको दाल सेलाउने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time also includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: मासको दाल सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, सेलाएर मसिनो पिँध्नुहोस्, अनि ताडको सख्खर र अलैंची हालेर पिँध्नुहोस्। तातो घ्यूसँग मिसाएर लड्डु बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then add palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mix with hot ghee and make laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप सेतो मासको दाल ⟦1⟧फुटेको, बोक्राबिनाको (मिनपप्पु), लगभग 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप कोरेको ताडको सख्खर ⟦1⟧लगभग 180 g, हल्का थिचेर भरेको; पहिले टुक्रा कुटेर वा कोरेर⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed and filled; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप घ्यू ⟦1⟧पगालेको र तातो; 1–2 ठूलो चम्चा थप तयार राख्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons extra ready⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: मासको दालबाट साना ढुंगा केलाएर निकाल्नुहोस्। नपखाल्नुहोस्; भुट्नका लागि सुख्खै रहनुपर्छ।
seg.99983266b588.back: Pick out small stones from the urad dal. Do not wash; it must stay dry for roasting.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: दाललाई बाक्लो प्यानमा मन्द आगोमा राख्नुहोस्।
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Put the dal in a heavy pan on low heat.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: मासको दाललाई मन्द आगोमा सुनौलो भएर भुटेको बदामजस्तो बास्ना नआउन्जेल लगभग 10 मिनेट सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्। हरेक दाना एकनास रङ्गियोस् भनेर लगातार चलाउनुहोस्; भुटेको बास्ना आउनुपर्छ र एउटा दाना टोक्दा कट्ट भाँचिनुपर्छ।
seg.65588a76c883.back: Dry-roast the urad dal on low heat about 10 minutes until golden and a roasted-nut aroma comes. Stir constantly so every grain colours evenly; a roasted aroma should come and a grain should snap crisply when bitten.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: दाललाई थालमा खन्याएर फिँजाउनुहोस्। सेलाएपछि मसिनो धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्। मिक्सर नततोस् भनेर छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्, र मोटा टुक्रा चालेर फेरि पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Pour the dal onto a plate and spread it. After it cools grind to a fine powder. Pulse briefly so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out coarse bits and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
