seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ताडको सख्खर मसिनो कोर्नुहोस्, वा कडा डल्ला फुटाउँदै टुक्राहरूलाई खलमा कुट्नुहोस्।
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar breaking up hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सरको जारमा दालको धुलोमा सख्खर र अलैंचीको धुलो हाल्नुहोस्। सख्खर र अलैंची एकनास नमिसिउन्जेल पिँध्नुहोस्। केही पटक घुमाए पुग्छ; सबै चौडा कचौरामा खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: In the mixer jar add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder. Grind until the jaggery and cardamom are evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; pour everything into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: सानो प्यानमा घ्यू तातो तर धुवाँ ननिस्कने गरी पगाल्नुहोस्।
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: In a small pan melt the ghee hot but without smoking.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: तातो घ्यू खन्याउनुहोस्, राम्ररी मिसाउनुहोस् र साना डल्ला थिचेर बनाउनुहोस्। पहिले धेरैजसो घ्यू हालेर चम्चाले मिसाउनुहोस्, अनि छुन मिल्ने गरी सेलाएपछि हातले मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. First add most of the ghee and mix with a spoon, then once cool enough to touch mix by hand.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: सानो मुठी लिएर मुट्ठीमा कसेर थिच्नुहोस्, अनि हत्केलाबीच गोलो गुडाउनुहोस्। खुकुलो भएर फुट्यो भने कचौरामा अझ एक चम्चा तातो घ्यू हालेर मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a small handful and press it tight in your fist, then roll round between your palms. If it is loose and breaks, add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: राख्नुअघि लड्डुलाई थालमा 15–20 मिनेट कडा हुन दिनुहोस्।
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Let the laddus firm up on a plate 15–20 minutes before storing.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: दाल नडढी भित्रसम्म पाकोस् भनेर मन्द आगोमा भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast on low heat so the dal cooks through without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: दाल पूरै सेलाएपछि मात्र पिँध्नुहोस्; तातो दाल मिक्सरमा लेदो हुन्छ।
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind only after the dal has cooled completely; hot dal turns into a paste in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मिश्रण अझै मनतातो छँदै लड्डु बनाउनुहोस्; घ्यूको तातोले यो सबैभन्दा राम्रोसँग जोडिन्छ।
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Make the laddus while the mixture is still lukewarm; with the warmth of the ghee it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ताडको सख्खरका टुक्रा फरक-फरक कडा हुन्छन्, त्यसैले मिक्सरमा हाल्नुअघि कोरेर वा कुटेर साना बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before putting in the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: उखुको सख्खर: अलि हल्का रङ र क्यारामेलजस्तो गुलियोपनका लागि त्यति नै कोरेको उखुको सख्खर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a slightly lighter colour and caramel-like sweetness use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: बोक्रासहित: केही गाउँले घरहरूमा बनाइनेझैँ अझ गाढा, दानेदार सुन्नुण्डलुका लागि बोक्रासहितको कालो फुटेको मासको दाल प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for darker, grainier sunnundalu as made in some village homes, use black split urad dal with skin.

seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: चिनीसँग: फिक्का रङका, कुरकुरे भएर मुखमा पग्लिने लड्डुका लागि सख्खरको सट्टा ¾ कप पिँधेको चिनी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for pale-coloured laddus that are crisp and melt in the mouth, use ¾ cup powdered sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: साँझ चिया वा कफीसँग मिठाईको रूपमा, वा संक्रान्ति र दिवालीको मिठाईको थालको भागको रूपमा पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with evening tea or coffee, or as part of the sweet platter for Sankranti and Diwali.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: हावा नछिर्ने स्टिलको बट्टामा कोठाको तापक्रममा राख्नुहोस् र 2 हप्ताभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। गर्मी मौसममा फ्रिजमा अझ धेरै दिन टिक्छन्; खानुअघि कोठाको तापक्रममा आउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and finish within 2 weeks. In hot weather they keep even more days in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why don't my sunnundalu form balls?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मिश्रणलाई अझ तातो घ्यू चाहिन्छ, वा यो सेलाइसक्यो। एक-दुई चम्चा घ्यू तताएर मिसाउनुहोस् र मिश्रण अझै मनतातो छँदै लड्डु बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has already cooled. Heat one or two spoons of ghee and mix in and make the laddus while the mixture is still lukewarm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can sunnundalu be made from palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: सकिन्छ। ताडको सख्खर (ताटि बेल्लम) मसिनो कोर्नुहोस् वा कुट्नुहोस् र उखुको सख्खर जति नै प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। लड्डु अलि गाढा रङका हुन्छन् र स्वाद अझ गहिरो, अलिकति धुवाँजस्तो हुन्छ।
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (tati bellam) finely and use the same amount as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become slightly darker in colour and the taste deeper, slightly smoky.

seg.946f64207639.back: How many days do sunnundalu keep?

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा कोठाको तापक्रममा लगभग 2 हप्ता, र फ्रिजमा अझ धेरै। निकाल्दा सुख्खा चम्चा वा सुख्खा हात प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands when taking them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: बोक्रासहितको मासको दाल प्रयोग गर्ने कि बोक्राबिनाको?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal with skin or without skin be used?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आन्ध्रमा दुवैबाट बनाइन्छ। बोक्राबिनाको सेतो मासको दालले चिल्ला, हल्का खैरा लड्डु बन्छन्; बोक्रासहितको कालो मासको दालले अझ गाढा, दानेदार लड्डु बन्छन्।
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra they are made from both. Skinless white urad dal makes smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin makes darker, grainier laddus.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: సున్నుండలు. आन्ध्रका सुन्नुण्डलु: भुटेको मासको दाल ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खरसँग पिँधेर तातो घ्यूले लड्डु बनाइएको। चरणबद्ध विधि, सुझाव र प्रायः सोधिने प्रश्नहरू।
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with tati bellam palm jaggery and made into laddus with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and frequently asked questions.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुण्डलु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9658e353fa37.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Tomata Pachadi · Tamatar ki chutney (tomato chutney)

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टमाटा पच्चडि आन्ध्रका भान्साको दैनिक चटनी हो: पाकेका गोलभेडा भुटेको दालसँग तेलमा गलुन्जेल पकाइन्छ, अनि खुर्सानी, लसुन र अलिकति इमलीसँग मोटो पिँधिन्छ। धेरै घरमा अझै पनि यसलाई ढुंगाको रोटि (सिलौटो) मा पिँधिन्छ, ताकि खस्रो, चम्चाले खान मिल्ने बनोट होस्, यद्यपि मिक्सरमा छोटो-छोटो घुमाए पनि काम चल्छ। यो तातो भात र घ्यू, डोसा, इडली र पेसरट्टुसँग खाइन्छ।
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomata pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes are cooked in oil with roasted dal until melted, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. In many homes it is still ground on a stone slab (silauto), so it has a coarse, spoonable texture, though pulsing briefly in a mixer also works. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: हाम्रो सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले यसलाई गाढा रातो रङ र एकनासको मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ, र गोलभेडासँगै अलिकति बेसार धुलो हालिन्छ। यो रेसिपीले लगभग 1½ कप बन्छ।
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and an even medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: जम्मा समयमा पिँध्नुअघि गोलभेडा सेलाउने 5 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time also includes 5 minutes of cooling the tomatoes before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: दाल र मेथी तेलमा भुट्नुहोस्, गोलभेडालाई बेसार र नुनसँग गलुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्, अनि सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो, लसुन र इमलीसँग मोटो पिँध्नुहोस्। अन्त्यमा रायो र करी पातको तड्का लगाउनुहोस्।
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until melted, then grind coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end temper with mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 ठूलो चम्चा तेल ⟦1⟧बदाम वा तिलको तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ सानो चम्चा मेथीको दाना ⟦1⟧यो भन्दा बढी नहाल्नुहोस्, नत्र पच्चडि तितो हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧do not add more than this, otherwise the pachadi becomes bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 वटा मझौला गोलभेडा ⟦1⟧लगभग 500 g, पाकेका र राता, काटेका⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧अझ पिरो पच्चडिका लागि 1 ठूलो चम्चासम्म⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.f7c3bb463ff4.t: गुच्चा जत्रो इमली ⟦1⟧लगभग 5 g, बिउ निकालेको⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.t: ¼ कप हरियो धनियाँ (चाहे मात्र) ⟦1⟧मोटो काटेको⟦/1⟧
seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup green coriander (optional only) ⟦1⟧coarsely chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: कराहीमा मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा 2 ठूलो चम्चा तेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadai on less than medium heat.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: मासको दाल, चनाको दाल र मेथी तेलमा सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्; निकाल्नुहोस्। यसमा 2–3 मिनेट लाग्छ; लगातार चलाउनुहोस्, किनकि मेथी छिट्टै डढेर तितो हुन्छ।
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in the oil until golden; take out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir constantly, because fenugreek quickly burns and turns bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: त्यही तेलमा काटेका गोलभेडा हालेर मध्यम आगोमा एक मिनेट चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add the chopped tomatoes and stir on medium heat for a minute.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: गोलभेडालाई बेसार र नुनसँग नरम भएर रस नसुकुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्। पहिलो 5 मिनेट छोप्नुहोस्, अनि बीचबीचमा चलाउँदै नछोपी पकाउनुहोस्, जम्मा लगभग 12–15 मिनेट, गोलभेडा गलेर छेउमा तेल नदेखिउन्जेल।
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in total, until the tomatoes melt and oil shows at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्, तातोमा नरम होस् भनेर इमली मिसाउनुहोस्, र सबैलाई लगभग 5 मिनेट सेलाउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the heat, mix in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: ढुंगाको रोटि (सिलौटो) वा मिक्सरको जारमा पहिले भुटेको दाल र मेथीलाई मोटो धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On a stone slab (silauto) or in a mixer jar first grind the roasted dal and fenugreek to a coarse powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: दाल, लसुन, इमली, खुर्सानीको धुलो र गोलभेडा मोटो पिँध्नुहोस्। मिक्सरमा दालको धुलोमा लसुन, खुर्सानीको धुलो र पकाएको गोलभेडा हालेर पानी नहाली 4–5 पटक छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्; अझै बनोट बाँकी छँदै रोक्नुहोस्। प्रयोग गर्ने भए हरियो धनियाँ मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind dal, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomato coarse. In the mixer add garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomato to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 short times without water; stop while there is still texture. Mix in green coriander if using.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: चाखेर मिलाउनुहोस्: अझ पिरो चाहिए एक चिम्टी बढी नुन, वा अलिकति बढी खुर्सानीको धुलो हालेर घुमाउनुहोस्।
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and adjust: if you want it hotter, a pinch more salt, or add a little more chilli powder and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडिलाई कचौरामा राख्नुहोस्। सानो प्यानमा 1 ठूलो चम्चा तेल तताएर रायोको दाना हाल्नुहोस्; चटचटाउन थालेपछि मासको दाल हालेर सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Put the pachadi in a bowl. In a small pan heat 1 tablespoon oil and add mustard seeds; once they start crackling add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: रातो खुर्सानी, हिङ र करी पात हालेर केही सेकेन्ड चलाउनुहोस्।
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chilli, hing and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: रायो, रातो खुर्सानी र करी पातको तड्का लगाएर माथि खन्याउनुहोस्। पस्कनुभन्दा ठीक अघि मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Temper mustard, red chilli and curry leaves and pour over the top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: पच्चडि धेरै दिन टिकोस् र काँचो स्वाद नआओस् भनेर गोलभेडाको रस नसुकुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: So the pachadi keeps many days and does not taste raw, cook until the tomato juice dries up.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पाकेका, गाढा राता गोलभेडाले सबैभन्दा राम्रो रङ दिन्छन्; तपाईंका गोलभेडा अमिला छन् भने इमली आधा गर्नुहोस्।
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the best colour; if your tomatoes are sour, halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्, मिक्सर लगातार नचलाउनुहोस्: आन्ध्रका घरहरूलाई मोटो पच्चडि मन पर्छ, र चिल्लो पेस्टमा त्यो बनोट हराउँछ।
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse briefly, do not run the mixer continuously: Andhra homes like a coarse pachadi, and a smooth paste loses that texture.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले मध्यम पिरो दिन्छ। 2 सानो चम्चाबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस् र चाखेपछि थप्नुहोस्; पच्चडि राखिराख्दा पिरो अलिकति कम हुन्छ।
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start with 2 teaspoons and add more after tasting; the heat reduces slightly as the pachadi stands.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हरियो खुर्सानी: खुर्सानीको धुलोको सट्टा दालसँगै भुटेका 4–5 वटा हरियो खुर्सानी प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder use 4–5 green chillies fried along with the dal.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: प्याज-गोलभेडा: गोलभेडा हाल्नुअघि 1 वटा काटेको प्याज नरम नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: before adding the tomatoes fry 1 chopped onion until soft.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: अझ पिरो: सन्नमको 1 सानो चम्चाको सट्टा 1 सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; तेजा धेरै पिरो हुन्छ, त्यसैले बिस्तारै थप्नुहोस्।
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 teaspoon of Sannam use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so add slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: लसुनबिना: लसुन नहाल्नुहोस् र तड्कामा एक चिम्टी बढी हिङ हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more hing in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: एक चम्चा तातो भातमा अलिकति घ्यूसँग मुछ्नुहोस्, वा डोसा, इडली, पेसरट्टु वा उपमासँग पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix into a spoon of hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: सफा, सुख्खा सिसाको बट्टामा फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 4 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and finish within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How to make Andhra tomata pachadi?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: मासको दाल, चनाको दाल र मेथी तेलमा भुट्नुहोस्, काटेका गोलभेडालाई बेसार र नुनसँग रस नसुकुन्जेल पकाउनुहोस्, अनि सबैलाई खुर्सानीको धुलो, लसुन र इमलीसँग मोटो पिँध्नुहोस्। अन्त्यमा रायो, रातो खुर्सानी र करी पातको तड्का लगाउनुहोस्।
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook the chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarse with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end temper with mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: मेरो टमाटा पच्चडि किन तितो भयो?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why did my tomata pachadi turn bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: प्रायः मेथीको दाना डढेर वा धेरै परेर। 500 g गोलभेडाका लागि ¼ सानो चम्चा मात्र प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र मध्यमभन्दा कम आगोमा भुट्नुहोस्, सुनौलो हुनेबित्तिकै निकाल्दै।
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Usually from the fenugreek seeds burning or too much going in. For 500 g tomatoes use only ¼ teaspoon and fry on less than medium heat, taking it out as soon as it is golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can tomata pachadi be made without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: सकिन्छ, तपाईंका गोलभेडा पर्याप्त अमिला छन् भने। पकाएपछि चाख्नुहोस्; पाकेका, गुलिया गोलभेडामा सन्तुलनका लागि इमलीको सानो टुक्रा चाहिन्छ।
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need a small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How many days does tomata pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: सफा, सुख्खा बट्टामा फ्रिजमा लगभग 4 दिन, गोलभेडा राम्ररी गलुन्जेल पकाइएको छ र सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ भने।
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: About 4 days in a clean, dry jar in the fridge, if the tomatoes were cooked until well melted and you use a dry spoon.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: టమాటా పచ్చడి. आन्ध्रको टमाटा पच्चडि: बेसार धुलोसँग गलुन्जेल पकाइएका गोलभेडा, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो, लसुन र इमलीसँग मोटो पिँधेर तड्का लगाइएको।
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomata pachadi: tomatoes cooked until melted with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind and tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टमाटा पच्चडि: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomata Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टमाटा पप्पु आन्ध्रका घरहरूको दैनिक दाल हो: रहरको दाल (कन्दि पप्पु) गोलभेडा र हरियो खुर्सानीसँग नरम पकाइन्छ, चिल्लो हुनेगरी मिचिन्छ र अन्त्यमा लसुनको तड्का लगाइन्छ। यो हप्ताका धेरैजसो दिन पकाइन्छ र तातो भात, एक चम्चा घ्यू र साथमा अप्पडम वा अचारसँग खाइन्छ।
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomata pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) is cooked soft with tomato and green chilli, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or pickle on the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: हाम्रो बेसार धुलो दालसँगै कुकरमा जान्छ र यसलाई गाढा पहेँलो रङ दिन्छ। सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोले हल्का रातो झल्को र अमिलो गोलभेडाको पछाडि रहने एकनासको मध्यम पिरो थप्छ। यो रेसिपी 4 जनालाई पुग्छ।
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a light red tinge and an even medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: जम्मा समयमा कुकरको बाफ आफैँ निस्कन दिने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time also includes the time for the cooker's steam to release on its own.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: रहरको दाललाई गोलभेडा, हरियो खुर्सानी र बेसार धुलोसँग प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्, सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुनसँग मिच्नुहोस्, र अन्त्यमा लसुन र रायोको तड्का लगाउनुहोस्।
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Pressure cook toor dal with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप रहरको दाल ⟦1⟧कन्दि पप्पु, लगभग 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ सानो चम्चा बेसार धुलो ⟦1⟧कुकरमा हाल्ने⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧to put in the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 सानो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧मिचेपछि हाल्ने; अझ पिरोका लागि 2 सानो चम्चासम्म⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧to add after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for hotter⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧½ cup more to adjust⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 ठूलो चम्चा इमलीको पानी (चाहे मात्र) ⟦1⟧गोलभेडा धेरै अमिला छैनन् भने⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (optional only) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: रहरको दाललाई 2–3 पानीमा पखालेर पानी तर्काउनुहोस्।
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: दाललाई गोलभेडा, हरियो खुर्सानी, प्याज र 2½ कप पानीसँग प्रेसर कुकरमा राख्नुहोस्।
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomato, green chilli, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: दाललाई गोलभेडा, हरियो खुर्सानी र बेसार धुलोसँग 4 सिट्ठीसम्म प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्। बिर्को लगाउनुअघि बेसार धुलो पानीमा घोल्नुहोस्, अनि मध्यम आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Pressure cook the dal with tomato, green chilli and turmeric powder up to 4 whistles. Dissolve the turmeric powder in the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्, लगभग 10 मिनेट। दुई औंलाबीच एउटा दाना पूरै मिचिएपछि दाल पाकेको हुन्छ।
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure release on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is cooked once a grain mashes fully between two fingers.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: राम्ररी मिच्नुहोस्; खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुन हाल्नुहोस्। काठको मथानी (पप्पु गुत्ति) वा डाडुको पछाडिको भाग प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र दाल तातै छँदा गोलभेडा र दाल एउटै चिल्लो मिश्रण नहुन्जेल मिच्नुहोस्।
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and while the dal is still hot mash until the tomato and dal become one smooth mixture.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: अलिकति पानी हालेर 5 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्। खन्याउन मिल्ने बाक्लोपनका लागि ½ कपसम्म पानी, र प्रयोग गर्ने भए इमलीको पानी हाल्नुहोस्, र पिँधमा नटाँसियोस् भनेर आगो मन्द राख्नुहोस्।
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and cook 5 minutes on low heat. For a pourable thickness add up to ½ cup water, and tamarind water if using, and keep the heat low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: नुन र अमिलोपन चाख्नुहोस्, अनि हरियो धनियाँ मिसाएर आगो बन्द गर्नुहोस्।
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then mix in green coriander and turn off the heat.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: सानो प्यानमा मध्यम आगोमा घ्यू तताएर रायोको दाना हाल्नुहोस्; चटचटाउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: In a small pan heat ghee on medium heat and add mustard seeds; let them crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: रायो, जीरा, लसुन र करी पात घ्यूमा भुटेर माथि खन्याउनुहोस्। रायोपछि जीरा, लसुन र सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी हालेर लसुन सुनौलो नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, अनि करी पात र हिङ हाल्नुहोस्, र छ्वाँक्छ्वाँक गर्दै गरेको तड्का दालमाथि खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee and pour over the top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dried red chillies and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: तड्काको स्वाद दालमा बसोस् भनेर 2 मिनेट छोप्नुहोस्, अनि चलाएर तातै पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Cover 2 minutes so the tempering's flavour settles into the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: चिल्लो पप्पुका लागि दाल तातै छँदा मिच्नुहोस्। सेलाएपछि दाना जम्छन् र डल्ला-डल्ला रहन्छन्।
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For a smooth pappu mash the dal while it is hot. After cooling the grains set and stay lumpy.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो मध्यम पिरो हुन्छ। 1 सानो चम्चाबाट सुरु गर्नुहोस्; अझ पिरो पप्पुका लागि 2 सानो चम्चासम्म बढाउनुहोस्।
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu increase up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पाकेका, अमिला देसी गोलभेडा (नाटु टमाटा) ले सबैभन्दा राम्रो स्वाद दिन्छन्; कम अमिला हाइब्रिड गोलभेडा भए इमलीको पानी हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomata) give the best flavour; if they are less sour hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: करी पात हाल्नुअघि तड्कामा लसुनलाई सुनौलो हुन दिनुहोस्; फिक्का लसुनको स्वाद काँचो लाग्छ।
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before adding curry leaves; pale garlic tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो: अझ पिरो पप्पुका लागि सन्नमको सट्टा ½ सानो चम्चा तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। तेजा धेरै पिरो हुन्छ, त्यसैले 1 सानो चम्चाभन्दा बढी नहाल्नुहोस्।
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकुर टमाटा पप्पु: मिचेपछि दालमा 2 कप काटेको पालुङ्गो हाल्नुहोस् र 5 मिनेट मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomata pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and cook 5 minutes on low heat.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: पहेँलो मुगको दालबाट बनाउनुहोस् र 2 सिट्ठीसम्म मात्र पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make it from yellow moong dal and cook only up to 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: बाफमा पकाएको तातो भात, एक चम्चा घ्यू र साथमा अप्पडम वा आवकायसँग तातै पस्कनुहोस्। चपातीसँग पनि मिठो हुन्छ।
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with hot steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and appadam or avakaya on the side. Also tasty with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: बचेको दाल छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। चिसोमा दाल बाक्लो हुन्छ; पस्कनुअघि अलिकति तातो पानी हालेर राम्ररी तताउनुहोस्।
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Cover leftover dal and keep in the fridge and finish within 2 days. In the cold the dal thickens; before serving heat well with a little hot water.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेसर कुकरमा रहरको दाललाई कति सिट्ठी चाहिन्छ?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles does toor dal need in the pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्यम आगोमा लगभग 4 सिट्ठी, अनि प्रेसर आफैँ झर्न दिनुहोस्। पुरानो दाल वा राम्ररी नपखालिएको दाललाई 5 सिट्ठी चाहिन सक्छ।
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure release on its own. Old dal or dal not washed well may need 5 whistles.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टमाटा पप्पु र साम्बरमा के फरक छ?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomata pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टमाटा पप्पु साधारण तड्का भएको बाक्लो, मिचिएको दाल हो, साम्बर मसला वा तरकारीबिना। साम्बर पातलो हुन्छ, जसमा इमली, तरकारी र भुटेको मसलाको धुलो हालिन्छ।
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomata pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering, without sambar masala or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, with tamarind, vegetables and roasted spice powder added.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: प्रेसर कुकरबिना टमाटा पप्पु बनाउन सकिन्छ?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can tomata pappu be made without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: सकिन्छ। दाललाई 30 मिनेट भिजाउनुहोस् र छोपेको भाँडोमा 3½ कप पानीसँग बीचबीचमा चलाउँदै सजिलै मिचिने नहुन्जेल लगभग 40–45 मिनेट पकाउनुहोस्।
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot with 3½ cups water, stirring now and then, about 40–45 minutes until it mashes easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: मेरो टमाटा पप्पु किन धेरै अमिलो भयो?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why did my tomata pappu turn too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: केही गोलभेडा धेरै अमिला हुन्छन्। दाललाई केही मिनेट बढी मन्द आगोमा पकाउनुहोस् र सन्तुलनका लागि एक चिम्टी सख्खर वा एक चम्चा थप मिचेको दाल मिसाउनुहोस्।
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Cook the dal a few minutes longer on low heat and mix in a pinch of jaggery or an extra spoon of mashed dal for balance.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: టమాటో పప్పు · आन्ध्रको गोलभेडा दालको रेसिपी | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: టమాటో పప్పు. आन्ध्रको गोलभेडा दाल: गोलभेडा र हरियो खुर्सानी, हाम्रो बेसार र सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलोसँग नरम पकाइएको रहरको दाल, लसुनको तड्कासहित। 4 जनालाई।
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomato and green chilli, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, with a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टमाटा पप्पु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomata Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney
seg.9078b361da10.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · वेल्लुल्लि कारम · लहसुन की सूखी चटनी
seg.9078b361da10.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Karam · Lahsun ki sukhi chutney (dry garlic chutney)

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम आन्ध्रका खाने टेबलमा राखिने लसुन-खुर्सानीको पोडि हो: रातो खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रशस्त लसुन, भुटेको धनियाँ र जीरा, र नुनसँग कुटिन्छ। घ्यूसँग तातो भातको पहिलो गाँसमा मुछेर, वा अलिकति तेलसँग इडली र डोसामाथि छरेर खाँदा, व्यस्त दिनमा यो छिटो खाना बन्छ र टिफिन बक्समा सधैँ हुन्छ।
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic-chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder is pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first mouthful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it makes a quick meal on busy days and is always in the tiffin box.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: हाम्रो तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोले यसलाई गुन्टुरका घरहरूलाई मन पर्नेझैँ गाढा रातो र धेरै पिरो बनाउँछ। कम पिरोका लागि आधा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot as Guntur homes like. For less heat use half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: जम्मा समयमा पिँध्नुअघि दाना र लसुन सेलाउने समय पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time also includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धनियाँ र जीरा भुटेर पिँध्नुहोस्, अनि तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, नुन र हल्का तताएको लसुनसँग छोटो-छोटो घुमाएर मोटो पोडि बनाउनुहोस्। तातो भात र घ्यू, इडली वा डोसासँग खानुहोस्।
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast and grind coriander and cumin, then pulse briefly with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: 25 पोटी लसुन ⟦1⟧लगभग ½ कप, बोक्रा छोडाएको; भित्रको पातलो झिल्ली रहे पनि हुन्छ⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 cloves garlic ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; it is fine if the thin inner skin remains⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो ⟦1⟧धेरै पिरो; कम पिरो बनाउन सुझाव हेर्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it less hot⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 वटा सानो गुच्चा जत्रो इमली (चाहे मात्र) ⟦1⟧सुख्खा, बिउ निकालेको⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: 1 small marble-sized tamarind (optional only) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: घ्यू वा तेल ⟦1⟧प्रति थाल 1 सानो चम्चा⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per plate⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लसुनको बोक्रा छोडाएर पोटीहरूलाई कपडाले थपथपाउँदै पूरै सुकाउनुहोस्; अलिकति पानीले पनि पोडि टिक्ने समय घटाउँछ।
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves fully dry with a cloth; even a little water reduces how long the podi keeps.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धनियाँ र जीराको दाना बास्ना नआउन्जेल सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्; सेलाउन दिनुहोस्। सानो प्यानमा मध्यमभन्दा कम आगो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; यसमा 1–2 मिनेट लाग्छ, र धनियाँ एक रङ गाढा हुनुपर्छ, खैरो होइन।
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Dry-roast coriander and cumin seeds until aromatic; let cool. Use less than medium heat in a small pan; it takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should be one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लसुनलाई 1 सानो चम्चा तेलमा 2 मिनेट तताउनुहोस्। आगो मन्द राखेर चलाउनुहोस्; पोटीहरू खैरो नभई किनारामा अलिकति नरम हुनुपर्छ। सेलाउन दिनुहोस्।
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should be slightly soft at the edges without browning. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: दानालाई धुलो हुनेगरी पिँध्नुहोस्, अनि खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुनसँग छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्। प्रयोग गर्ने भए इमली दानासँगै हाल्नुहोस्, ताकि एकनास पिँधियोस्।
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse briefly with chilli powder and salt. If using tamarind add it with the seeds so it grinds evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लसुन हालेर छोटो-छोटो घुमाउँदै मोटो, ओसिलो धुलो बनाउनुहोस्। हरेक 2–3 पटक घुमाएपछि रोकेर जारको भित्तामा टाँसिएको लसुन तल झार्नुहोस्।
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse briefly into a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 pulses stop and push down the garlic stuck to the jar walls.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: ढुंगाको खलमा पहिले दाना कुट्नुहोस्, अनि नुनसँग लसुन, र अन्त्यमा खुर्सानीको धुलो मिसाउँदै कुट्नुहोस्।
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and finally pound mixing in the chilli powder.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: एक चिम्टी अलिकति भात र घ्यूसँग चाख्नुहोस्, र चाहिए नुन थप्नुहोस्।
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: बाफ निस्कोस् भनेर पोडिलाई थालमा 10 मिनेट फिँजाउनुहोस्, अनि सफा, सुख्खा बट्टामा भर्नुहोस्।
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Spread the podi on a plate 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then fill into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा धेरै पिरो हुन्छ; कम पिरो पोडिका लागि आधा सन्नम प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, वा उत्तिकै लसुनका लागि खुर्सानीको धुलो घटाएर 3 ठूलो चम्चा बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi use half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder to 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लसुन राम्ररी सुकाउनुहोस् र तेलमा तताउनुहोस्; ओसिलो लसुनले पोडि छिट्टै बिगार्छ।
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic spoils the podi quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: छोटो-छोटो घुमाउनुहोस्, मिक्सर लगातार नचलाउनुहोस्: धेरै बेर चलाए लसुन पेस्ट बन्छ।
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse briefly, do not run the mixer continuously: if run too long the garlic becomes a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: एक कप तातो भातमा 1 सानो चम्चा पोडि र 1 सानो चम्चा घ्यू मुछ्नुहोस्; स्वादअनुसार मिलाउनुहोस्।
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: दालसँग: भुटेको बदामजस्तो स्वाद भएको, अलि कम पिरो पोडिका लागि दानासँगै 1 ठूलो चम्चा चनाको दाल र 1 ठूलो चम्चा मासको दाल सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dal: for a roasted-nut-flavoured, slightly less hot podi dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal along with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: काँचो लसुन: अझ तीखो स्वादका लागि लसुन नतताउनुहोस्, र एक हप्ताभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste do not warm the garlic, and finish it within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: मध्यम पिरो: 2 ठूलो चम्चा तेजा र 2 ठूलो चम्चा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: तातो भात र घ्यूको पहिलो गाँससँग मुछ्नुहोस्, वा अलिकति तेल वा घ्यूसँग इडली, डोसा वा पेसरट्टुमाथि छर्नुहोस्।
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with the first mouthful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: सफा, सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा कोठाको तापक्रममा लगभग 2 हप्ता, वा फ्रिजमा एक महिना राख्नुहोस्। सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or in the fridge one month. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धनियाँ र जीराको दाना भुटेर पिँध्नुहोस्, खुर्सानीको धुलो र नुन हाल्नुहोस्, अनि बोक्रा छोडाएका लसुनका पोटी हालेर छोटो-छोटो घुमाउँदै मोटो, ओसिलो धुलो बनाउनुहोस्। आन्ध्रका घरमा प्रायः यसलाई ढुंगाको खलमा कुटिन्छ।
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast and grind coriander and cumin seeds, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse briefly into a coarse, moist powder. In Andhra homes it is usually pounded in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: लसुनको पोडि कम पिरो कसरी बनाउने?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: आधा तेजाको सट्टा आधा सन्नम खुर्सानीको धुलो प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्, वा जम्मा 3 ठूलो चम्चा खुर्सानीको धुलो मात्र। प्रशस्त घ्यूसँग खाँदा पनि तिखोपन घट्छ।
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Use half Sannam chilli powder instead of half the Teja, or only 3 tablespoons chilli powder in total. Eating it with plenty of ghee also reduces the sharpness.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How many days does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा कोठाको तापक्रममा लगभग 2 हप्ता, वा फ्रिजमा एक महिना। धेरै दिन टिकोस् भनेर लसुन राम्ररी सुकाएर पहिले तेलमा तताउनुहोस्।
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or one month in the fridge. So it keeps many days, dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: खुर्सानीको धुलोको सट्टा साबुत सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can whole dried red chillies be used instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: सकिन्छ। लगभग 20 वटा सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी केही थोपा तेलसँग कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल सुख्खै भुट्नुहोस्, सेलाएर लसुन हाल्नुअघि पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. आन्ध्रको लसुन-खुर्सानीको पोडि: भुटेको धनियाँ र जीरा लसुन, नुन र तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलोसँग कुटिएको। तातो भात र घ्यू, वा इडली र डोसासँग मुछेर खानुहोस्।
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic-chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Eat mixed with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्लि कारम: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.2b0c8026598d.t: 1 वटा सानो गुच्चा जत्रो इमली (चाहे मात्र)

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: कुखुराको मासुमा दही, तेजा खुर्सानीको धुलो, बेसार धुलो र नुन दलेर मोल्नुहोस्। 30 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्। त्यति बेला कचौरा छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस्।
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt into the chicken meat and massage. Leave 30 minutes. For that time cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g माछाका टुक्रा ⟦1⟧कडा मासु भएको माछा, बाक्ला टुक्रामा काटेको: रहु, भाकुरा (बोच्च), कोरमीनु (मरेल) वा सीर माछा (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm-fleshed fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakura (boccha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g इमली ⟦1⟧लगभग कागती जत्रा दुई डल्ला, 2 कप मनतातो पानीमा 15 मिनेट भिजाएको⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized lumps, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: बचेको पुलुसु छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। प्यानमा नचलाई बिस्तारै, भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तातो नहुन्जेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftover pulusu, keep in the fridge and finish eating within 2 days. Heat gently in a pan without stirring, until hot enough to steam all the way to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: बाक्ला टुक्रामा काटिएको कडा मासुको नदी वा समुद्री माछा: रहु, भाकुरा (बोच्च), मरेल (कोरमीनु) वा सीर माछा। काँडा धेरै हुने साना माछा पनि चल्छन् तर बिस्तारै चलाउनुपर्छ।
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm-fleshed river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, bhakura (boccha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Small fish with many bones also work but must be stirred gently.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: बचेको पुलुसु छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। अलिकति पानी हालेर प्यानमा, भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तातो नहुन्जेल तताउनुहोस्।
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftover pulusu, keep in the fridge and finish eating within 2 days. Adding a little water, heat in a pan until hot enough to steam all the way to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटन वेपुडु: 500 g हड्डीबिनाको खसीको मासुलाई मसला र ½ कप पानीसँग 5–6 सिट्ठीसम्म, नरम नहुन्जेल प्रेसर कुकरमा पकाउनुहोस्, अनि त्यसैगरी भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless goat meat with the masala and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker up to 5–6 whistles, until soft, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: दुवै चल्छन्। हड्डीबिनाको मासु छिटो पाक्छ र बढी कुरकुरे हुन्छ; हड्डीसहितका साना टुक्रामा स्वाद बढी हुन्छ तर आफ्नै रसमा 6–8 मिनेट बढी पकाउनुपर्छ।
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless meat cooks fast and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes more cooking in their own juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: टिफिन वा छोटो यात्राका लागि पोको पार्नुभयो भने लगभग 4 घण्टाभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। बचेको भात छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र एक दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If you packed it for a tiffin or a short trip, finish eating within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover rice, keep in the fridge and finish eating within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: कि कागतीको रस पकाइयो, कि बेसार तेलमा डढ्यो। बेसार सबैभन्दा पछि हाल्नुहोस्, तुरुन्तै चुलो बन्द गर्नुहोस् र 5–10 सेकेन्ड मात्र चलाउनुहोस्; कागतीको रस आगोबाट हटाएर भातमा हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add turmeric at the very last, turn off the stove immediately and stir only 5–10 seconds; take off the fire and add the lemon juice to the rice.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: अर्को कप पानी बाक्लो पिँध भएको प्यानमा खन्याउनुहोस्; पातलो प्यानमा रागि पिँधमा टाँसिन्छ।
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the other cup of water into a thick-bottomed pan; in a thin pan the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: रागि जावामा उखुको सख्खर प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: सकिन्छ। उत्तिकै मात्रामा कोरेको उखुको सख्खर (चेरुकु बेल्लम) लिनुहोस् र दूध नफाटोस् भनेर चुलो बन्द गरेपछि मिसाउनुहोस्। यसले हल्का रङ र नरम, क्यारामेलजस्तो गुलियोपन दिन्छ।
seg.a9a06390a945.back: It can. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and mix it in after turning off the stove so the milk does not split. It gives a light colour and soft, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: बचेको छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 1 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्। प्यानमा भित्रसम्मै बाफ आउने गरी तातो नहुन्जेल मात्र तताउनुहोस्; योभन्दा बढी बेर तताउँदा झिँगे माछा कडा हुन्छ।
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftover, keep in the fridge and finish eating within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until hot enough to steam all the way to the inside; heating longer than this makes the prawns hard.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made from sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: सकिन्छ। उखुको सख्खर (चेरुकु बेल्लम) मसिनो कोर्नुहोस् र ताडको सख्खर जति नै प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। लड्डु हल्का रङका हुन्छन् र गुलियोपन नरम, क्यारामेलजस्तो हुन्छ।
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: It can. Grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same as palm jaggery. The laddus become light-coloured and the sweetness soft, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: काँचो लसुन: अझ तीखो स्वादका लागि लसुन नतताउनुहोस्; फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 3 दिनभित्र खाइसक्नुहोस्।
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for an even sharper taste do not heat the garlic; keep in the fridge and finish eating within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: सफा, सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र 2 हप्ताभित्र प्रयोग गरिसक्नुहोस्। सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight container in the fridge and finish using within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: सुख्खा, हावा नछिर्ने बट्टामा फ्रिजमा 2 हप्तासम्म। लसुन राम्ररी सुकाएर पहिले तेलमा तताउनुहोस्, र सधैँ सुख्खा चम्चा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्।
seg.367798df40e3.back: Up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight container. Dry the garlic well and heat it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: सकिन्छ। लगभग 20 वटा सुकेका रातो खुर्सानी केही थोपा तेलमा कुरकुरे नहुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्, सेलाएर लसुन हाल्नुअघि पिँध्नुहोस्।
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: It can. Fry about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet poha with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु तेलुगु घरहरूको 10 मिनेटमा बन्ने मिठाई हो। यो कृष्णाष्टमीमा कृष्णलाई चढाइने चिउरा हो, कुचेलाको उपहारको सम्झनामा, र स्कुलबाट आएपछि बच्चाहरूका लागि छिटो बन्ने मिठाई पनि हो। चिउरालाई धोइन्छ मात्र, पानीमा कहिल्यै पकाइँदैन, अनि मनतातो सख्खरको पाकमा मिसाइन्छ।
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the same poha that is offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in memory of Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only washed, never cooked in water, then mixed into lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: हाम्रो ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खरले यसलाई गाढा खैरो रङ र भरपूर, हल्का धुवाँ जस्तो गुलियो स्वाद दिन्छ। यो रेसिपी 2 जनाका लागि हो।
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Tati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a dark brown colour and a rich, light smoke-like sweet taste. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: तयारीमा धोएको चिउरा नरम हुन लाग्ने 5 मिनेट पनि जोडिएको छ।
seg.25e28614accb.back: The preparation includes 5 minutes for the washed poha to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: बाक्लो चिउरा नरम बनाउनुहोस्, नरिवल र अलैंचीसँगै मनतातो ताडको सख्खरको पाकमा मिसाउनुहोस्, र अन्त्यमा घ्यू हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick poha, mix it with coconut and cardamom into lukewarm palm jaggery syrup, and put ghee on top.

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप कोरेको ताडको सख्खर ⟦1⟧लगभग 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ कप कोरेको नरिवल ⟦1⟧सेतो भाग मात्र⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ सानो चम्चा अलैंचीको धुलो ⟦1⟧वा 2–3 वटा अलैंचीका कुटेका दाना⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: चिउरा छानीमा राख्नुहोस् र भुसका टुक्रा टिपेर निकाल्नुहोस्।
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out the pieces of husk.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: चिउरालाई छानीमा राखेर बगिरहेको पानीमुनि केही सेकेन्ड धुनुहोस्, पानी निथार्नुहोस्, र नरम हुन 5 मिनेट छोड्नुहोस्। थिच्दा नरम लाग्नुपर्छ, तर भिजेको होइन।
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Keep the poha in a sieve and wash it for a few seconds under running water, drain the water, and leave it 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ताडको सख्खरलाई मसिनो कोर्नुहोस्, कडा डल्ला भए फोड्नुहोस्।
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery fine, break any hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ताडको सख्खरलाई 2 ठूलो चम्चा पानीसँग मन्द आगोमा पगाल्नुहोस्, अनि छान्नुहोस्। प्यान पुछेर पाक फेरि त्यसमा खन्याउनुहोस्।
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low heat, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: काजु हाल्ने हो भने अलिकति घ्यूमा सुनौलो हुन्जेल भुट्नुहोस्।
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If adding cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: मनतातो पाकमा चिउरा, नरिवल र अलैंची हाल्नुहोस् र मन्द आगोमा 1–2 मिनेट, हरेक चिउरामा पाक लागिसक्ने गरी, बिस्तारै मिसाउनुहोस्। हात हल्का राख्नुहोस् ताकि चिउरा नभाँचियोस्।
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and gently mix on low heat for 1–2 minutes, until every poha piece has syrup on it. Keep a light hand so the poha does not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: चिउरामा पाक लागेको बित्तिकै प्यान आगोबाट झार्नुहोस्; धेरै बेर पकाउँदा चपाउन गाह्रो हुन्छ।
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the syrup coats the poha, take the pan off the fire; cooking too long makes it hard to chew.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: अन्त्यमा घ्यू र काजु हाल्नुहोस्। तातै वा कोठाको तापक्रममा पस्कनुहोस्।
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finally add ghee and cashews. Serve hot (while hot) or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: बाक्लो चिउरा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। पातलो चिउरा पाकमा लेदो हुन्छ।
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick poha. Thin poha becomes mush (ledo) in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: चिउरालाई कचौराभरि पानीमा भिजाउनु हुँदैन; छिटो धोए पुग्छ, नत्र नरम र टाँसिने हुन्छ।
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the poha in a bowlful of water; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: चिउरा हाल्दा पाक मनतातो राख्नुहोस्, उम्लिरहेको होइन, ताकि चिउरामा बराबर लागोस्।
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the poha, so that it coats the poha evenly.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दूधसँग: तयार चिउरामा 2–3 ठूलो चम्चा मनतातो दूध खन्याउनुहोस्, मिठाई अझ नरम हुन्छ।
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: pour 2–3 big spoons of lukewarm milk over the prepared poha, the sweet will be softer.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिलसँग: नरिवलसँगै 1 ठूलो चम्चा भुटेको तिल हाल्नुहोस्।
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 big spoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टमीमा नैवेद्यको रूपमा पस्कनुहोस्, वा स्कुलपछि बच्चाहरूका लागि छिटो बन्ने मिठाईका रूपमा।
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: बनाएकै दिन खानु राम्रो। बचेको छोपेर फ्रिजमा राख्नुहोस् र भोलिपल्ट खानुहोस्; राखिरहँदा चिउरा कडा हुँदै जान्छ।
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Best eaten on the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat the next day; the poha becomes hard when kept.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुका लागि कुन चिउरा सबैभन्दा राम्रो?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which poha is best for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: बाक्लो चिउरा (अटुकुलु)। मनतातो पाकमा यसको आकार टिक्छ; पातलो चिउरा लेदो हुन्छ।
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick poha (atukulu). It keeps its shape in lukewarm syrup; thin poha becomes mush.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: के बेल्लम अटुकुलु उखुको सख्खरले बनाउन सकिन्छ?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: सकिन्छ। त्यति नै परिमाणमा कोरेको उखुको सख्खर (चेरुकु बेल्लम) प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। रङ हल्का हुन्छ, र गुलियोपन क्यारामेल जस्तो।
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Take the same quantity of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). The colour is light, and the sweetness is caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: मेरो बेल्लम अटुकुलु किन टाँसिने भयो?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: चिउरा धेरै बेर भिजेको वा पकाइएको थियो। केही सेकेन्ड मात्र धुनुहोस्, र हरेक चिउरामा पाक लागेको बित्तिकै प्यान आगोबाट झार्नुहोस्।
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as the syrup coats each poha piece.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: यसले कुचेलाको कथा सम्झाउँछ, जसले आफ्ना मित्र कृष्णलाई एकमात्र उपहारका रूपमा मुट्ठीभर चिउरा ल्याएका थिए।
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought just a handful of poha as a gift for his friend Krishna.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. आन्ध्रको बेल्लम अटुकुलु: बाक्लो चिउरा नरिवल, अलैंची र घ्यूसँग मनतातो ताटि बेल्लम ताडको सख्खरको पाकमा मिसाइएको। 10 मिनेटको मिठाई, सुझाव र बारम्बार सोधिने प्रश्नसहित।
seg.5080241b3883.back: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra's Bellam Atukulu: thick poha mixed with coconut, cardamom and ghee in lukewarm Tati Bellam palm jaggery syrup. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and questions-and-answers.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet poha with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु: 1acrefarms को रेसिपी कार्ड, सामग्री र विधिसहित
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.cf5b9ab6ccf1.back: Andhra sweet · about 14 pieces are made

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: कोब्बरि उण्डलु आन्ध्रका घरमा चाडपर्व, नैवेद्य र दैनिक मिठाईका लागि बनाइने नरिवलका लड्डु हुन्। यसका लागि नरिवल, सख्खर, अलैंची र एक चम्चा घ्यू मात्र चाहिन्छ। सख्खर पगालेर छानिन्छ, त्यसमा नरिवललाई मन्द आगोमा मिश्रण एकसाथ टाँसिने बन्दासम्म पकाइन्छ, र लड्डु तातै हुँदा हातले बनाइन्छ।
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu are the coconut laddus that are made in Andhra homes for festivals, naivedyam and everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on low heat until the mixture joins together, and the laddus are shaped by hand while warm.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: हाम्रो चेरुकु बेल्लमले यसलाई हल्का सुनौलो रङ र नरम, क्यारामेल जस्तो स्वाद दिन्छ। यो रेसिपीबाट लगभग 14 वटा लड्डु बन्छ।
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a soft, caramel-like taste. About 14 laddus are made from this recipe.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: राख्नुअघि लड्डु सेलाउन थप 15 मिनेट दिनुहोस्।
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Give the laddus another 15 minutes to cool before putting them away.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: उखुको सख्खर पगाल्नुहोस्, कोरेको नरिवलसँग मिश्रण एकसाथ टाँसिने बन्दासम्म पकाउनुहोस्, अलैंची र घ्यू हाल्नुहोस्, अनि लड्डु बनाउनुहोस्।
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery, cook it with the grated coconut until the mixture joins together, add cardamom and ghee, and shape the laddus.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 कप कोरेको नरिवल ⟦1⟧1 मझौला नरिवल; सेतो भाग मात्र कोर्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 कप कोरेको उखुको सख्खर ⟦1⟧लगभग 180 g; पहिले टुक्रा कुट्नुहोस् वा कोर्नुहोस्⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 ठूलो चम्चा घ्यू ⟦1⟧र हत्केलामा दल्न अलिकति⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 big spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little for the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10 वटा काजु, ऐच्छिक ⟦1⟧टुक्र्याएर घ्यूमा सुनौलो भुटेको⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: नरिवल कोर्नुहोस्, खैरो बोक्रा छोडिदिनुहोस् ताकि लड्डुको रङ हल्का रहोस्।
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leave the brown skin so that the laddus' colour stays light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: उखुको सख्खरलाई कुटेर वा कोरेर साना टुक्रा बनाउनुहोस् ताकि बराबर पग्लियोस्।
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Pound or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: सख्खरलाई 2 ठूलो चम्चा पानीसँग मन्द आगोमा पगाल्नुहोस्, अनि मसिनो छानीबाट छान्नुहोस्। यसले भेलीमा भएका किरकिरा कण र उखुका टुक्रा रोक्छ।
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low heat, then strain through a fine sieve. This holds back the gritty particles and sugarcane pieces that are in the bheli (jaggery lump).

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: यसलाई फेरि प्यानमा हाल्नुहोस्, नरिवल मिसाउनुहोस् र मध्यम-मन्द आगोमा चलाउँदै पकाउनुहोस्, मिश्रणले प्यानको छेउ छोड्ने र एकसाथ टाँसिने बन्दासम्म, 12–15 मिनेट। तलामा टाँसिन नदिन चलाइरहनुहोस्।
